ko.text: 개미 눈으로 보면 풀잎이 나무처럼 커다래요!
곡식을 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 날라 줘요!
창고 칸이 가득 찼어요! 하나부터 열까지, 열 칸!
베짱이와 꽃을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 봄 노래가 이어져요!
큰 잎을 톡 눌러서 개미들 우산을 펼쳐 줘요!
도토리를 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 데굴데굴 굴려요!
가을엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
너무 얇지도, 너무 두껍지도 않은 옷!
겨울엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
목도리와 털모자예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
눈 오는 날, 베짱이가 오들오들 떨며 창고 문을 두드렸어요.
"개미야, 먹을 것 좀 나눠 줄 수 있니?"
문을 톡 눌러서 활짝 열어 줄까요?
창고 안이 곡식이랑 도토리로 가득해요! 여름부터 미리 모은 덕분이에요.
먹을 게 이렇게 많으니 친구들도 불러요!
친구가 넷이나 왔어요! 먹을 게 많아서 모두 나눠 먹을 수 있어요.
반딧불이가 불을 밝히고, 겨울 음악회가 시작됐어요!
베짱이가 겨울 노래를 들려줘요. 가만히 들어 봐요.
베짱이랑 친구들을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 겨울 노래가 이어지고 춤을 춰요!
띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.
계절 카드를 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울 순서대로 톡 눌러 봐요!
봄은 어디 있을까? 봄 카드를 톡!
여름은 어디 있을까? 여름 카드를 톡!
가을은 어디 있을까? 가을 카드를 톡!
겨울은 어디 있을까? 겨울 카드를 톡!
봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.
미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.

en.text: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food.
Tap the marching ants!
Now tap the grasshopper!
Tap the green grasshopper!
"Summer is so fun! Tra-la-la~" The grasshopper sings a song.
Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!
Tap the grain to carry it to the storeroom!
Tap the yellow grain!
The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!
"Let's play together~ Tra-la-la!" the grasshopper sings.
Tap the grasshopper and the flowers. The spring song keeps going!
Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"
"Winter is still far away~" the grasshopper sang again.
Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!
Tap the big leaf to open an umbrella for the ants!
Tap the green leaf!
Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.
The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone. Achoo! But the grasshopper said, "It's okay~" and smiled.
Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.
Tap the acorns to roll them to the storeroom, roll, roll!
Tap the acorns!
The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!
The wind is cool. What should we wear in autumn?
The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ I'm a little cold.
The thick coat? Phew, so hot! Sweat is dripping!
What should we wear in autumn? Pick some clothes!
Not too thin, not too thick!
It's the jacket! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! A jacket is just right for cool autumn.
Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here. Brrr, so cold.
What should we wear in winter?
The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ It's too cold!
Ha ha, swimsuits are for summer~ Ooh, it's cold!
What should we wear in winter? Pick some clothes!
When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!
It's the scarf and the fur hat! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! With a scarf and a fur hat, it's warm.
The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.
On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.
"Ant, could you share some food with me?"
The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"
"I sang. Tra-la-la~"
"Then go dance all winter!"
Then the baby ant said, "But Grasshopper looks so cold."
Tap the door to open it wide?
Tap the storeroom door!
"Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."
"Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!"
The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.
They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.
There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends!
Tap the ladybug and invite it in!
One! A ladybug has come.
Tap the snail and invite it in!
Two! A snail has come.
Tap the pill bug and invite it in!
Three! A pill bug has come.
Tap the firefly and invite it in!
Four! A firefly has come.
Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.
The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!
The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.
Tap the grasshopper and friends. The winter song goes on, and everyone dances!
Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.
Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!
This time the grasshopper carries food too.
Tap the grasshopper, heave-ho, heave-ho!
"Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!"
Tap the season cards in order: spring, summer, autumn, winter!
Where is spring? Tap the spring card!
Spring is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the spring card!
Tap the spring card!
Where is summer? Tap the summer card!
Summer is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the summer card!
Tap the summer card!
Where is autumn? Tap the autumn card!
Autumn is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the autumn card!
Tap the autumn card!
Where is winter? Tap the winter card!
Winter is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the winter card!
Tap the winter card!
"I'm next~"
Number one, spring!
Number two, summer!
Number three, autumn!
Number four, winter!
Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.
By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.

ko.text: 옛날에 상인에게 딸이 셋 있었어요. 막내 벨은 마음이 고와서 모두 '미녀'라고 불렀어요.
어느 날 배들이 가라앉아, 가족은 시골 작은 집으로 갔어요.
배 한 척이 돌아왔대요! 아버지가 도시로 떠나요.
그런데 배의 짐은 남의 것이 되어, 아버지는 빈손으로 돌아오다 눈보라에 길을 잃었어요.
멀리 불빛! 커다란 궁전에 아무도 없고, 따뜻한 저녁상만 차려져 있었어요.
아버지는 배불리 먹고, 푹신한 의자에서 잠이 들었어요.
아침이 되자 눈 속에 장미가 활짝 피어 있었어요!
그 덤불은 장미가 두 송이예요. 적어요.
그 덤불은 장미가 다섯 송이예요. 많아요.
자리를 바꿨어요. 장미가 적은 덤불은 어느 쪽일까요?
그때 덤불 뒤에서 커다란 야수가 천천히 나왔어요.
내 장미를 꺾었구나. 재워 주고 먹여 줬는데.
나리가 아니라 야수라고 불러라. 장미를 꺾었으니 벌을 받아야 해. 네가 돌아오든지, 딸 하나가 스스로 오든지.
착하구나. 아버지는 내일 아침 집으로 가거라.
방 문에 '벨의 방'이라고 쓰여 있어요. 책도 많고, 장미도 있어요.
벨, 잘 지냈니? 나와 결혼해 줄래?
벨은 날마다 친절하게 대답했고, 둘은 친구가 되었어요.
창밖은 아침, 낮, 밤으로 바뀌어요. 아침부터 차례로 눌러 봐요.
맞아요, 밤! 아침, 낮, 밤. 하루가 이렇게 지나가요.
어느 날, 벨은 거울로 집을 보았어요.
다녀와요. 하지만 일주일 뒤엔 꼭 돌아와요. 안 오면 나는 너무 슬플 거예요.
자기 전에 이 반지를 탁자에 놓으면, 아침에 여기로 돌아와요.
다음 날 아침, 벨은 집에 와 있었어요.
해가 뜨고 지고, 일주일이 훌쩍 지났어요. 어느 밤, 벨은 꿈을 꾸었어요.
벨은 반지를 탁자에 놓고 다시 잠이 들었어요.
아침이 되자 벨은 궁전 정원에 있었어요. 야수는 샘가에 힘없이 누워 있었어요.
사랑해요, 야수님. 제 남편이 되어 주세요.
그러자 반짝! 야수가 멋진 왕자님으로 변했어요.
고마워요, 벨. 겉모습만 보지 않고 내 마음을 봐 줬어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a merchant had three daughters. The youngest, Belle, was so kind-hearted that everyone called her Beauty.
One day his ships sank, and the family moved to a small cottage in the countryside.
It's all right. I will do the housework.
One of the ships came back! Father is leaving for the city.
A silk dress for me! And rings and ribbons too!
A single rose is all I need.
All right. I will be back soon.
Tap the horse.
Clip-clop, clip-clop. Father rode off to the city.
But the ship's goods now belonged to someone else. Father came home empty-handed and lost his way in a snowstorm.
A light far away! In a huge palace there was no one at all, only a warm supper laid out on the table.
Is anyone here? ... Thank you, I will gladly eat.
Father ate his fill and fell asleep in a soft armchair.
In the morning, roses were blooming in the snow!
Which bush has MORE roses?
That bush has two roses. That is fewer.
That bush has five roses. That is more.
That's right, five roses! That bush has more.
They switched places! Which bush has FEWER roses?
That's right, two roses! That bush has fewer.
Just one rose, for Belle.
Then, from behind the bush, a huge Beast slowly came out.
You picked my rose. After I gave you a bed and a meal.
I am sorry, my lord. My youngest daughter asked for it.
Do not call me lord. Call me Beast. You picked my rose, so you must be punished. Either you come back, or one of your daughters comes here of her own free will.
Father came home holding the rose.
The Beast... said one of my daughters must go to him.
It is because of my rose. I will go.
No, Belle.
It's all right. I want to go.
Father brought Belle all the way to the palace.
Did you come here of your own free will?
Yes.
You are a good girl. Your father shall go home tomorrow morning.
On the door it says 'Belle's Room'. There are lots of books, and roses too.
Find the rose ON the table.
Find the rose UNDER the table.
Find the rose BESIDE the table.
That one is on the table.
That one is under the table.
That one is beside the table.
That's right, on the table!
That's right, under the table!
That's right, beside the table!
Every evening, the Beast came to see her.
Belle, how are you? Will you marry me?
No, Beast. But I like you very much as a friend.
Then I will come again tomorrow evening.
Belle answered kindly every day, and the two became friends.
Outside the window it turns morning, day, and night. Tap them in order, starting with morning.
That is daytime. Where is the morning?
That is night. Where is the morning?
That's right, morning! What comes after morning?
That is night. What comes after morning?
That's right, daytime! What comes after daytime?
That's right, night! Morning, day, night. That is how a day goes by.
One day, Belle looked at her home through the magic mirror.
Father is ill...
Go to him. But come back in one week, without fail. If you do not, I will be so very sad.
Put this ring on the table before you sleep, and in the morning you will be back here.
I will come back. I promise.
The next morning, Belle was home.
Thanks to you, I am all better.
Stay just a little longer. Please? Just a little.
Maybe I could...
The sun rose and set, and a whole week slipped by. One night, Belle had a dream.
Beast! I broke my promise. I must go back.
Belle put the ring on the table and fell asleep again.
In the morning, Belle was in the palace garden. The Beast lay by the spring, weak and still.
Beast, wake up!
Tap the spring water.
Belle... you came back.
I love you, Beast. Please be my husband.
And then, a flash of light! The Beast turned into a handsome prince.
Thank you, Belle. You did not judge me by my looks. You saw my heart.
The fairy's spell is broken at last.
Father and her sisters came running too.
And they all lived happily together in the palace.
Look at the heart, not the looks.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 방앗간에 늙은 당나귀가 살았어요.
당나귀는 오랫동안 무거운 곡식 자루를 날랐어요. 이제는 힘이 없어요.
주인: "이제 일을 못 하겠구나. 너를 내보내야겠다."
당나귀: "괜찮아! 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 될 거야!"
멍멍 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
야옹 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
꼬끼오 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
당나귀: "그럼 우리 같이 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 되자!"
당나귀: "우리랑 음악대 하자! 네 목소리 최고야!"
당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭. 네 친구가 모였어요!
길가 풀밭에서 노래 연습을 해요. 당나귀가 먼저 들려줄게요. 잘 듣고 똑같이 톡톡!
이번엔 세 개! 잘 들어 봐요.
하하, 새 노래가 됐네! 한 번 더!
해가 지고 캄캄한 숲이 되었어요. 부엉이가 부엉부엉.
불빛이 새어 나오는 창문이에요. 그런데 너무 높아서 아무도 안 닿아요.
서로 등에 올라서 탑을 쌓아요! 크고 무거운 친구가 맨 아래예요.
흔들흔들! 더 크고 무거운 친구가 먼저예요.
당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭! 닭이 창문에 닿았어요!
창문 안을 들여다보니, 도둑 셋이 금화를 세며 맛있는 걸 먹고 있어요.
도둑을 놀라게 할 노래예요. 먼저 들어 봐요!
네 친구는 남은 음식을 냠냠 먹고, 불을 끄고 잠이 들었어요.
한밤중, 도둑 하나가 살금살금 돌아왔어요. 쉿!
아궁이 안에서 뭔가 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
문 앞에 또 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
저 위 들보에서도 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
도둑: "그 집엔 귀신이 할퀴고, 누가 다리를 콕 찌르고, 거인이 쿵 차고, 지붕에선 재판관이 도둑 잡아라! 소리쳤어!"
사실은 고양이, 강아지, 당나귀, 닭이었는데 말이에요! 도둑들은 다시는 오지 않았어요.
아침이 밝았어요. 네 친구는 이 집이 참 좋았어요.
이번에는 친구들을 톡톡 눌러서 같이 연주해요!

en.text: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.
Give the donkey a tap!
Tap the donkey!
The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.
Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."
Donkey: "That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!"
The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.
Woof, woof, from behind the bush! Who could it be?
Who goes woof, woof? Listen again.
Who goes meow? Listen again.
Who goes cock-a-doodle-doo? Listen again.
It's the donkey! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the dog! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the rooster! Tap the sparkling friend!
The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.
Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."
Donkey: "Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!"
A meow from up on the wall! Who could it be?
This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."
Dog: "Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!"
A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof! Who could it be?
Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."
Donkey: "Join our band! Your voice is the best!"
Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!
Let's practice singing on the grassy roadside. The donkey will go first. Listen well, then tap just the same!
This time there are three! Listen carefully.
This is the last song. Listen carefully.
Now tap just the same!
Ha ha, that made a brand-new song! Try once more!
Whose sound came first?
Whose sound came next?
Woof, meow! Well done!
Hee-haw, woof, cock-a-doodle-doo! What a wonderful song!
Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!
The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.
Let's walk through the forest.
Tap, tap, tap! Through the forest we go.
The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.
Rooster: "I see a light over there! There's a house!"
Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.
Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower! The biggest, heaviest friend goes at the bottom.
Who will stand at the bottom?
Who goes at the very top?
Who will climb onto the donkey's back?
Who will climb onto the dog's back?
Dog: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Cat: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Rooster: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.
The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.
Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!
Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.
Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"
Rooster: "Let's play our music nice and loud!"
This song will scare the robbers. Listen first!
This time, tap the friend who is singing!
All together, as loud as you can!
Tap, tap, tap the tower! Sing even louder!
The robbers yelled, "A monster!" and scampered off into the forest.
The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.
In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!
Something is sparkling in the fireplace! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!"
Another sparkle by the door! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Ow! Something poked my leg!"
There's a sparkle in the pile of straw, too! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Yikes! Something kicked me, boom!"
And another sparkle up on the high beam! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Help me~!"
Robber: "In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'"
It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.
Morning came. The four friends loved this house.
"We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!"
Let's play the song of joy!
This time, tap the friends and play together!
Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.

ko.text: 어느 날, 궁전에서 무도회 편지가 왔어요.
신데렐라, 내 머리 좀 예쁘게 해 줘!
울지 마렴. 너도 무도회에 가고 싶지? 내가 도와주마.
생쥐가 여섯 마리! 하얀 말 여섯 마리가 되었어요.
큰 쥐는 마부가, 도마뱀은 시종이 되었어요.
신데렐라는 은빛 드레스에 유리 구두를 신었어요.
꼭 기억하렴. 밤 열두 시가 되면 마법이 풀린단다.
시계를 보니 열두 시가 가까워요. 신데렐라는 약속대로 집에 돌아왔어요.
신데렐라는 춤추느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
긴 바늘과 짧은 바늘이 모두 12를 가리키면 열두 시예요. 열두 시 시계를 찾아봐요!
바늘이 모두 위로 올라가면 열두 시예요.
신데렐라는 계단을 달려 내려가다 유리 구두 한 짝을 떨어뜨렸어요.
이 구두가 꼭 맞는 사람을 찾을 거예요.
왕자님이 유리 구두를 들고 집집마다 찾아다녔어요.
언니들의 발은 너무 커서 들어가지 않았어요.
신데렐라는 주머니에서 다른 한 짝을 꺼냈어요.
요정 대모가 다시 고운 옷을 입혀 주었어요.
착한 마음은 나를 괴롭힌 사람도 용서할 수 있어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.
You work in the kitchen!
Ashy girl! Ashy girl!
So the girl was called Cinderella.
One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!
Cinderella, do my hair nicely!
Yes, I will make it pretty.
Tap your sister's hair!
Oh, how pretty!
The sisters happily went off to the ball.
Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.
I wish I could go to the ball, too.
Then her fairy godmother appeared.
Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.
Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.
Tap the pumpkin!
The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!
There are mice in the trap. How many are there?
Tap the mousetrap!
Six mice! They became six white horses.
The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.
Now it is your turn, dear.
Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.
Oh, thank you so much!
Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.
Yes, I will remember!
When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.
Please, dance with me.
Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.
Oh, thank you!
The sisters did not know who she was.
The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.
The next night, there was another ball.
Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.
When the long hand and the short hand both point to twelve, it is twelve o'clock. Find the clock that says twelve!
Find the clock that says twelve!
That is three o'clock.
That is six o'clock.
When both hands point straight up, it is twelve o'clock.
That's right, twelve o'clock!
Oh no, it's twelve o'clock!
Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.
I will find the person this slipper fits.
The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.
My foot will fit!
My foot will fit, too!
The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.
May I try it on, too?
Find the foot that is the same size as the slipper!
That foot is bigger than the slipper.
That's right, the small foot!
The slipper fit perfectly!
Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.
Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.
Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time. We are truly sorry.
It's all right. Let's be happy together.
Tap to say hello to Cinderella!
Everyone laughed together.
A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.

ko.text: 두루미가 놀러 왔어요. 그런데 접시가 아주 납작해요!
두루미 부리를 톡 눌러서 먹게 해 줘요!
어머나, 부리 끝만 딱딱 닿아요. 수프를 먹을 수가 없어요.
여우는 혀로 핥핥, 다 먹었어요. 두루미는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
며칠 뒤, 이번엔 두루미가 여우를 불렀어요.
여우 코를 톡 눌러서 먹게 해 줘요!
여우 코를 한 번 더 톡!
여우 코를 톡! 폴짝 뛰어 봐요!
어머나! 여우 코가 병에 쏙 끼었어요!
두루미는 긴 부리로 쪽쪽 먹었어요. 여우는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
둘 다 못 먹었어요. 왜 그랬을까요?
두루미는 부리가 길쭉해요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
길쭉한 부리가 쏙 들어가는 그릇을 찾아봐요!
여우는 입이 짧아요. 혀로 핥아 먹어요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
혀로 핥기 좋은 납작한 그릇을 찾아봐요!
여우랑 두루미가 함께 잔치를 열었어요. 손님들도 와요!
입 모양을 잘 보고, 알맞은 그릇을 골라 줘요!
여우는 입이 짧아요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
오리는 부리가 넓적해요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
나비는 입이 빨대 같아요. 무엇이 좋을까요?
길쭉한 부리가 쏙 들어가는 걸 찾아봐요!
혀로 핥기 좋은 납작한 걸 찾아봐요!
넓적한 부리로 푹 떠먹기 좋은 걸 찾아봐요!
빨대 입으로 쪽 빨아 먹는 걸 찾아봐요!
납작 접시예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
긴 병이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
넓은 그릇이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
등불이 반짝, 모두 모여 잔치를 해요.
친구들을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 냠냠 맛있게 먹어요!

en.text: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.
Fox brought an invitation.
Tap the invitation and give it to Crane!
"Wow, thank you!" Crane hopped up on those long legs.
Fox is cooking some yummy soup.
Shall we tap the pot and stir it?
Tap the pot and stir, stir, stir!
Fox giggles. "I'll serve it on a flat plate~"
Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!
Tap Crane's beak to help Crane eat!
Tap Crane's beak!
Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.
Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.
A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.
"Fox, come over to my house too~"
Fox was so excited. "Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!"
Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower! The neck is so long.
Tap Fox's nose to help Fox eat!
Tap Fox's nose!
Tap Fox's nose one more time!
Tap Fox's nose! Let's hop!
Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!
Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!
Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.
Neither of them could eat. Why was that?
Crane has a long, thin beak. Which dish is best?
Find the dish where a long beak fits right in!
Fox has a short mouth and licks food up. Which dish is best?
Find a flat dish that's good for licking!
Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!
Look at each mouth, and pick the right dish!
Fox has a short mouth. Which dish is best?
Duck has a wide, flat beak. Which dish is best?
Butterfly has a mouth like a straw. What is best?
Find the one where a long beak fits right in!
Find a flat one that's good for licking!
Find one that's good for scooping with a wide beak!
Find one to sip from with a straw mouth!
Crane is here!
Fox is here!
Duck is here!
Butterfly is here!
It's the flat plate! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the tall bottle! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the wide bowl! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the flower! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! Crane likes the tall bottle.
That's right! Fox likes the flat plate.
That's right! Duck likes the wide bowl.
That's right! Butterfly likes the flower.
The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.
Fox said, "I'm sorry, Crane."
Crane said, "I'm sorry too, Fox."
"It's okay!" The two became good friends again.
Tap your friends. Eat up, nom nom, yummy!
They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.

ko.text: 연못에 아침이 왔어요. 아기 개구리들이 아직 쿨쿨 자고 있네요.
아기 개구리들을 톡 눌러서 깨워 줄까요?
자고 있는 아기 개구리를 톡 눌러 봐요!
아기 개구리들이 몰래 풀밭으로 나왔어요. 톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝 가 볼까요?
가운데 그림이랑 똑같이 생긴 쪽을 골라 봐요!
커다란 황소였어요! 아기 개구리들은 깜짝 놀라 도망쳤어요.
누가 더 큰지 키를 재 볼까요?
누가 더 커요? 큰 친구를 눌러 봐요!
둘이 나란히 섰어요. 머리가 더 높은 친구는 누구지?
개구리가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
오리가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
양이 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
황소가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
"와, 양만큼 커졌다! 그래도 황소가 더 커요!"
엄마개구리가 부들부들 떨려요. 어어… 한 번 더 누르면 어떻게 될까?
푸슈슈슉~ 엄마개구리가 풍선처럼 날아다녀요! 톡 눌러서 잡아 줘요!
엄마개구리는 원래 크기로 돌아왔어요. 어지러워도 깔깔깔 웃었답니다.
황소도 따라 뛰어 볼까요? 하나, 둘…
쿵! 황소는 폴짝 뛰지 못했어요. 누가 더 멀리 뛸까요? 개구리!
밤이 되었어요. 나비넥타이를 맨 삼촌 개구리가 놀러 왔어요. 개구리 가족이 노래를 불러요. 먼저 들어 봐요!
이번에는 개구리를 톡톡 눌러서 같이 불러요!
개굴개굴~ 노래가 잦아들고, 개구리 가족은 쿨쿨 잠이 들었답니다.

en.text: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.
Shall we tap the baby frogs to wake them up?
Tap a sleeping baby frog!
Mama Frog said. "Children, don't go far away~"
The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow. Shall we tap and hop along?
Tap the screen to hop, hop, hop!
Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!
What could this be? A tail or a tree?
Pick the one that looks just like the picture in the middle!
It's a tail! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a tail!
What is it this time? A hoof or a pebble?
It's a hoof! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a hoof!
What could this be? A horn or a branch?
It's a horn! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a horn!
It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.
"Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!"
Mama Frog said. "Hmph, how big was it?"
Shall we see who is bigger?
Who is bigger, the frog or the tadpole?
Who is bigger, the tadpole or the frog?
Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!
They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?
The frog is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The frog is bigger!
Who is bigger, the duck or the frog?
Who is bigger, the frog or the duck?
The duck is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The duck is bigger!
Who is bigger, the sheep or the duck?
Who is bigger, the duck or the sheep?
The sheep is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The sheep is bigger!
Who is bigger, the ox or the sheep?
Who is bigger, the sheep or the ox?
The ox is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The ox is bigger!
"I can be as big as an ox!" Mama Frog took a deep breath.
Shall we tap, tap, and puff up Mama Frog?
Tap, tap, tap Mama Frog!
"The ox is still bigger!"
"Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!"
Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling. Uh-oh... what happens if we tap one more time?
Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon! Tap to catch her!
Tap Mama Frog as she flies!
Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.
The ox bent down low and said kindly. "It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!"
Tap Mama Frog to hop!
Shall the ox try hopping too? One, two...
Thud! The ox couldn't hop. Who can jump farther? The frog!
Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song. Listen first!
This time, tap the frogs and sing along!
Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.

ko.text: 옛날 어느 성에 금빛 공을 가장 좋아하는 공주가 살았어요.
그건 네모예요. 금공 모양을 다시 찾아봐요.
그건 세모예요. 금공 모양을 다시 찾아봐요.
통통통! 내 금공은 세상에서 제일 예뻐.
어느 날, 공주는 숲속 샘가에서 공놀이를 했어요.
공이 샘 속으로 풍덩! 금공이 깊은 물속으로 가라앉았어요.
엉엉, 내 금공… 내 금공이 사라졌어.
그때 샘물 위로 초록 개구리가 고개를 내밀었어요.
내가 공을 찾아 줄게. 대신 나랑 친구가 되고, 같이 먹고, 한 침대에서 자 줄래?
개구리는 풍덩 물속으로 들어가 금공을 물고 올라왔어요.
공주는 공을 받아 안고 성으로 쌩 달려갔어요.
저녁 식사 때, 문 밖에서 폴짝폴짝 소리가 났어요. 똑똑!
공주님, 약속했잖아요. 문 좀 열어 줘요.
그 모습을 본 임금님이 공주에게 물었어요.
개구리가 금공을 찾아 주면… 친구가 되겠다고 했어요.
약속은 지켜야 한단다. 도와준 친구에게는 더욱 그렇지.
접시에 빵이 몇 개일까요? 접시를 톡 눌러 봐요.
빵이 세 개! 너 하나, 나 하나, 남은 하나는 나눠 먹자.
밤이 되자 개구리가 공주의 방까지 따라왔어요.
공주는 개구리를 침대 쪽으로 휙 던졌어요. 개구리는 푹신한 베개 위에 포옥!
고마워요. 나는 마법에 걸린 왕자였어요. 약속을 지켜 줘서 마법이 풀렸어요.
다음 날, 공주와 왕자는 성 뜰에서 함께 놀았어요.
둘은 금공을 주고받으며 오래오래 사이좋게 지냈답니다.

en.text: Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a princess who loved her golden ball more than anything.
What shape is the golden ball? Pick one!
That's a square. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
That's a triangle. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
That's right, a circle! The golden ball is round like a circle.
Bounce, bounce! My golden ball is the prettiest in the whole world.
One day, the princess played with her ball beside a spring in the forest.
The ball went up high, and higher... oh my!
Splash! The ball fell into the spring and sank deep down into the water.
Boo-hoo, my golden ball... my golden ball is gone.
Just then, a green frog poked his head up out of the water.
Princess, why are you crying?
My golden ball fell into the spring. Sniff, sniff.
I'll get your ball for you. But in return, will you be my friend, eat with me, and let me sleep in your bed?
Okay, I promise!
The frog dived into the water, splash, and came back up with the golden ball in his mouth.
My ball!
The princess grabbed the ball and ran straight home to the castle.
Wait! You promised!
At supper time, there came a hop, hop sound outside the door. Knock, knock!
Princess, you promised. Please open the door.
No! Go away!
The king saw this and asked the princess.
My princess, what did you promise?
I said that if the frog found my golden ball... I would be his friend.
A promise must be kept. Even more so to a friend who helped you.
...Yes, Father.
The princess brought the frog to the table.
I promised, so let's eat together.
How many buns are on the plate? Tap the plate!
Three buns! One for you, one for me, and we'll share the last one.
Yum yum, delicious!
When night came, the frog followed the princess all the way to her room.
Princess, you said I could sleep in your bed.
Ugh, that's enough!
The princess tossed the frog toward the bed. Plop! He landed softly on the fluffy pillow!
Thank you. I was a prince under a spell. Because you kept your promise, the spell is broken.
Oh my, the frog... was a prince!
The next day, the princess and the prince played together in the castle garden.
Now we are true friends.
Yes! Let's play ball together!
And the two of them tossed the golden ball back and forth and were the best of friends for a long, long time.

ko.text: 숲속 통나무집에 곰 세 식구가 살았어요.
아빠 곰은 굵은 목소리, 아기 곰은 가느다란 목소리예요.
엄마 곰이 맛있는 죽을 끓였어요. 그런데 너무 뜨거워요!
아빠 곰: "죽이 식을 동안 산책 다녀오자!"
문이 삐걱 열렸어요. 골디락스가 살짝 들어가 봤어요.
식탁 위에 죽이 세 그릇 있어요.
김이 펄펄 나면 뜨겁고, 얼음이 있으면 차가워요.
너무 크지도, 너무 푹신하지도 않은 의자예요.
뿌지직! 작은 의자가 부서져서 엉덩방아를 찧었어요.
이번에는 침대를 톡 눌러 봐요. 자장가가 이어져요!
큰 그릇은 가장 큰 곰 거예요.
작은 그릇은 가장 작은 곰 거예요.
아기 곰: "내 죽을 다 먹어 버렸어!"
큰 의자는 가장 큰 곰 거예요.
엄마 곰이 아기 곰을 꼭 안아 주었어요.
아기 곰이 살금살금 가 보니, 누가 자고 있어요!
골디락스와 곰 세 마리 눈이 딱 마주쳤어요!
아빠 곰: "괜찮아. 다음엔 똑똑 하고 기다려 줘."
엄마 곰이 새 죽을 끓였어요. 다 함께 먹어요!
가장 작은 그릇부터 차례대로 톡 눌러요.
작은 그릇, 중간 그릇, 큰 그릇! 차례대로 담았어요.
골디락스 그릇도 하나 더! 다 함께 냠냠.
골디락스와 곰 가족은 사이좋은 친구가 되었답니다.

en.text: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.
Tap the bear family to say hello!
Tap a bear and say hi!
Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.
Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!
Tap once and blow on it for me!
Tap the porridge and blow! Whoo!
The steam is going down, but it's still hot.
Papa Bear: "Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!"
In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.
Tap, tap the screen and walk along with her!
Tap, tap! Walk with Goldilocks.
She picked three flowers. Oh? Look, a log cabin!
Wow, what a big door! Give it a knock.
Tap the door! Knock, knock.
Goldilocks: "Hello? Is anyone home?"
There is no answer.
The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.
There are three bowls of porridge on the table.
Which porridge is just right?
Hot, hot! It's way too hot!
It's way too cold, like ice!
Porridge with lots of steam is hot, and porridge with ice is cold.
It's the small bowl with just a little steam!
Just right! Yum, yum! She ate up the whole small bowl.
Now there are three chairs.
Which chair is just right?
It's too high! Her legs dangle, dangle.
It's so squishy, she sank right in!
It's the chair that's not too big and not too squishy.
It's the small chair! Tap the sparkling chair.
Just right! But then...
Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.
Yaaawn, I'm sleepy. There are three beds upstairs.
Which bed is just right?
It's too hard!
It's too soft!
It's the bed that's not too hard and not too soft.
It's the small bed! Tap the sparkling bed.
Just right! Let's hear a lullaby. Listen closely.
This time, tap the bed. The lullaby keeps going!
Goldilocks fell fast asleep. Zzz.
Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.
Papa Bear: "Who ate my porridge?"
The bowls are all mixed up. Help find each bowl's owner!
Whose is this big bowl?
The big bowl belongs to the biggest bear.
It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Mama Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Whose is this medium bowl?
The medium bowl belongs to the middle bear.
It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Papa Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Whose is this small bowl?
The small bowl belongs to the smallest bear.
It's Baby Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Mama Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "Someone ate up all my porridge!"
Who could it have been?
Now help find whose chair is whose.
Whose is this big chair?
The big chair belongs to the biggest bear.
Mama Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Whose is this medium chair?
The medium chair belongs to the middle bear.
Papa Bear: "My chair is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "Waaah, my chair is broken!"
Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.
But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.
Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!
Tap the blanket.
Tap the blanket with Baby Bear!
Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!
She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!
Goldilocks turned around and said, "I'm sorry."
Goldilocks: "I'm sorry I came in without asking."
Papa Bear: "It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us."
Goldilocks: "Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?"
Tap, tap to hammer and fix it!
Tap the chair! Bang, bang.
Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.
Baby Bear: "Thank you! Let's be friends!"
Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!
Tap the bowls in order, starting with the smallest.
Which is the smallest bowl?
Next is the medium bowl!
Last is the biggest bowl!
Find the big bowl.
Find the medium bowl.
Find the small bowl.
The big bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
The medium bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
The small bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
"I'm next~"
Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.
One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.
Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 숲 옆 작은 집에 헨젤과 그레텔이 살았어요.
헨젤은 빵 부스러기로 길을 표시하기로 했어요.
헨젤이 빵 부스러기를 하나씩 떨어뜨려요. 같이 세어 봐요!
빵 부스러기가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 길이 생겼어요.
빈터에는 빨간 산딸기가 가득했어요. 둘은 냠냠 따 먹었어요.
배가 부르니 졸려서 둘은 나무 밑에서 깜빡 잠이 들었어요.
눈을 떠 보니 아빠가 보이지 않았어요. 둘은 길을 잃었어요.
그레텔은 마음이 조금 무서웠어요. 그레텔을 톡! 꼭 안아 줘요.
그런데 이상해요. 빵 부스러기가 하나도 없어요!
작은 새가 빵 부스러기를 물고 있어요.
헨젤은 눈물이 글썽했지만 그레텔의 손을 꼭 잡고 걸었어요.
그때 달콤한 냄새가 솔솔 났어요. 앗, 과자 집이에요!
지붕에 사탕이 빠진 곳이 있어요. 헨젤이 하나씩 붙여 줘요. 같이 세어 봐요!
사탕이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 지붕이 예뻐졌어요.
그때 문이 열리고 마녀 할머니가 나왔어요.
그레텔은 마녀가 낮잠을 자는 사이에 열쇠 세 개를 가져왔어요.
새장 자물쇠에는 별 모양 구멍이 있어요. 별 모양 열쇠를 톡!
찰칵! 새장이 열렸어요. 헨젤이 폴짝 뛰어나왔어요!
그때 마녀가 일어나 쿵쿵 걸어왔어요. 눈이 나빠서 더듬더듬 찾았어요.
마녀가 화덕 안을 들여다봐요. 그레텔을 톡! 화덕 문을 쾅 밀어요.
쾅! 마녀는 깜짝 놀라 모자가 휙 날아갔어요.
집으로 가는 길에 넓은 강이 나왔어요. 다리가 없어요!
저 멀리 집이 보여요. 아빠가 숲에서 둘을 애타게 찾고 있었어요.
헨젤과 그레텔은 마음이 따뜻하고 행복했어요. 여러분은 기분이 어때요? 헨젤을 톡! 만세!
우리 집이 제일 포근해요. 헨젤과 그레텔 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, Hansel and Gretel lived in a little house beside the forest.
Children, let's go pick berries in the forest! said Papa.
Hansel decided to mark the way with bread crumbs.
Hansel drops the crumbs one by one. Let's count them together!
Tap Hansel, tap tap tap tap tap! Count the crumbs.
One, two, three, four, five crumbs! Now there is a trail.
The clearing was full of red berries. The two of them munched away.
With full tummies, they got sleepy and dozed off under a tree.
When they woke up, Papa was nowhere to be seen. They were lost.
Gretel felt a little scared. Tap Gretel and give her a hug.
Tap Gretel! Give her a big hug.
It's okay, let's follow the crumb trail! said Hansel.
But how strange! There were no crumbs left at all!
A little bird has a crumb in its beak.
Tweet tweet! They were so yummy, I ate them all! said the bird.
Hansel's eyes got teary, but he held Gretel's hand tight and kept walking.
Then a sweet smell drifted by. Oh! A candy house!
The walls are cookies and the roof is candy.
It was so yummy that their tummies got round and full.
Some candies are missing from the roof. Hansel sticks them on one by one. Let's count!
Tap Hansel, tap tap tap tap tap! Count the candies.
One, two, three, four, five candies! The roof looks lovely.
Then the door opened, and a witch granny came out.
Who ate my candy house? grumbled the witch.
The witch was a grumpy granny who kept all her sweets to herself.
The witch popped Hansel into a cage. Stay there until you pay for the candy!
While the witch napped, Gretel fetched three keys.
The cage lock has a star-shaped hole. Tap the star key!
Tap the star key!
Look closely at the shape of the key's head.
Tap the sparkly star key!
Click! The cage opened. Hansel hopped out!
Thank you, Gretel! said Hansel.
Then the witch woke up and stomped over. She could not see well, so she felt around for them.
Gretel had a clever idea. Witch, there is something sparkly in the oven!
The witch peeks into the oven. Tap Gretel and give the oven door a big push!
Tap Gretel! Push with a bang.
Bang! The witch jumped in fright, and her hat flew off.
The witch hopped on her broom and whooshed up the chimney. I won't come back again!
On the way home, they came to a wide river. There was no bridge!
Then a white duck came swimming.
Quack quack! Hop on my back! said the duck.
The duck carried them across the river. Thank you, Duck!
They could see their house far away. Papa had been searching the forest for them, so worried.
Hansel! Gretel! Papa came running.
Found you! I missed you so much! said Papa.
Hansel and Gretel felt warm and happy. How do you feel? Tap Hansel and cheer!
Tap Hansel! Hooray!
Home is the coziest place. That is how the story of Hansel and Gretel ended.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 동생 흥부와 욕심쟁이 형 놀부가 살았어요.
흥부는 배가 고파서 형 집으로 밥을 얻으러 갔어요.
형수가 주걱을 휘두르자 흥부 볼에 밥알이 붙었어요. 흥부는 그 밥알을 맛있게 먹었어요.
흥부네 초가집 처마에는 제비 가족이 살았어요.
아기 제비는 몇 마리일까요? 둥지를 톡톡톡 눌러서 세어 봐요!
둥지를 톡톡톡! 아기 제비를 세어 봐요.
아기 제비가 하나, 둘, 셋! 세 마리예요.
앗! 아기 제비 한 마리가 둥지에서 떨어졌어요!
흥부를 톡! 눌러서 아기 제비를 받아 줘요.
흥부는 아기 제비의 다친 다리에 천을 감아 주었어요. 아기 제비는 금방 나았어요.
가을이 되자 제비 가족은 따뜻한 남쪽 나라로 떠났어요.
봄이 되자 제비가 돌아와서 박씨 하나를 떨어뜨렸어요.
쑥쑥 자란 줄기에 박이 열렸어요. 줄기를 톡톡톡 눌러서 박을 세어 봐요!
박이 하나, 둘, 셋! 세 통이에요.
흥부 부부는 톱으로 박을 탔어요. 박을 톡! 눌러서 슬근슬근 타 봐요.
첫 번째 박에서 하얀 쌀이 쏟아졌어요! 아이들이 신나서 소리쳤어요.
쌀자루가 하나, 둘, 셋! 이제 배불리 먹을 수 있어요.
두 번째 박에서는 반짝반짝 금은보화가 나왔어요!
세 번째 박에서는 작은 박 요정들이 나와 멋진 새집을 지어 주었어요!
놀부는 제비집을 마구 흔들었어요. 아기 제비가 떨어졌어요!
놀부네 마당에도 박이 세 통 열렸어요.
박이 하나, 둘, 셋! 놀부는 기대에 부풀었어요.
콸콸콸! 박에서 흙탕물이 쏟아져서 놀부가 흠뻑 젖었어요.
와르르! 놀부의 집이 무너졌어요. 다행히 아무도 다치지 않았어요.
놀부는 흙투성이가 되어 흥부네 집을 찾아왔어요.
쌀자루를 톡! 눌러서 형님네 집으로 보내 줘요.
쌀자루가 하나, 둘, 셋! 놀부는 눈물이 핑 돌았어요.
흥부를 톡! 눌러서 모두 함께 만세!
흥부와 놀부는 그 뒤로 사이좋게 오래오래 살았대요. 착한 마음은 복이 되어 돌아와요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind younger brother, Heungbu, and his greedy older brother, Nolbu.
Tap Heungbu to say hello!
Tap Heungbu! Say hello.
Heungbu smiled and said hello.
Heungbu was hungry, so he went to his brother's house to ask for some rice.
His sister-in-law said with an angry face. "There is no rice here! Go away!"
She waved her rice paddle, and a few grains of rice stuck to Heungbu's cheek. Heungbu ate them happily.
Heungbu said with a smile. "It's okay. Even these grains are yummy!"
A swallow family lived under the eaves of Heungbu's little house.
How many baby swallows are there? Tap the nest, tap tap tap, to count!
Tap the nest, tap tap tap! Count the baby swallows.
One, two, three! There are three baby swallows.
Oh no! One baby swallow fell out of the nest!
Tap Heungbu to catch the baby swallow.
Tap Heungbu! Catch the swallow.
Heungbu wrapped a cloth around the baby swallow's hurt leg. The baby swallow got better soon.
When autumn came, the swallow family flew away to a warm country in the south.
When spring came, the swallow flew back and dropped one gourd seed.
Heungbu planted the seed in his yard.
The vine grew and grew, and gourds appeared. Tap the vine, tap tap tap, to count the gourds!
Tap the vine, tap tap tap! Count the gourds.
One, two, three! There are three gourds.
Heungbu and his wife cut the gourds with a saw. Tap a gourd to saw it, back and forth!
Tap the gourd! Saw, saw, saw.
White rice poured out of the first gourd! The children shouted with joy.
Tap the rice sacks, tap tap tap, to count them!
Tap the rice sacks, tap tap tap! Count them.
One, two, three rice sacks! Now they can eat until they are full.
Sparkling gold and jewels came out of the second gourd!
Tiny gourd fairies came out of the third gourd and built a wonderful new house!
When Nolbu heard the news, he felt jealous. "I will be rich too!"
Nolbu shook the swallow's nest hard. A baby swallow fell!
Nolbu hurriedly wrapped a cloth around it. "Now bring me a gourd seed!" The swallow was not hurt and flew away.
Three gourds grew in Nolbu's yard too.
One, two, three gourds! Nolbu was full of hope.
Tap the first gourd!
Splash! Muddy water poured out of the gourd and Nolbu got soaked.
This time, a Dokkaebi with a club popped out. "You greedy man!" The Dokkaebi gave Nolbu a fright and then disappeared.
Crash! Nolbu's house fell down. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
Nolbu, covered in mud, came to Heungbu's house.
Nolbu bowed his head. "Brother, I was wrong. I am sorry I was so greedy."
Heungbu smiled and said. "Brother, it's okay. Let's live together!"
Tap a rice sack to send it to your brother's house.
Tap a rice sack! Send it to your brother.
One, two, three rice sacks! Tears filled Nolbu's eyes.
Tap Heungbu for a big cheer together!
Tap Heungbu! Hooray, everyone!
After that, Heungbu and Nolbu lived happily together for a very long time. A kind heart brings good fortune back.

ko.text: 해가 쨍쨍한 날, 다현이와 이현이와 은우는 꿀떡이랑 산책을 나가요.
김이 뭉치고, 뭉치고… 퐁! 구름이 됐어요.
구름이 쏙! 토끼, 물고기, 자동차로 바뀌어요.
꿀떡이가 문틈에 코를 쏙 밀어 넣어요.
기다란 벨트 위로 물방울이 똑, 똑, 똑.
이현이가 물방울에 손을 살짝 대 봐요.
퐁! 토끼 구름. 퐁! 고래 구름.
구석에 아기 먹구름 하나가 혼자 웅크리고 있어요.
혼자 웅크리고 있어요. 슬픈 것 같아요.
슈웅— 아기 먹구름이 굴뚝으로 올라가요. 퐁!
삼남매도 손을 흔들며 밖으로 달려 나가요.
하늘에서 아기 먹구름이 큰 먹구름과 쿵!
무지개를 톡톡톡… 일곱 색을 세어 봐요!
비를 다 내린 아기 먹구름은 하얗게 변했어요.
하얀 아기 구름이 방긋 웃어요. 퐁!
꿀떡이는 젖은 흙에 코를 대고 킁킁.
삼남매는 꿀떡이랑 왔던 길로 집에 가요.
멀리 굴뚝에서 작은 구름이 퐁! 퐁!
꿀떡이는 굴뚝 쪽 바람을 마지막으로 킁킁.

en.text: On a sunny day, Dahyun, Ihyun, and Eunwoo go for a walk with Kkulddeok.
Clouds float across the sky.
Where do clouds come from?
Tap Kkulddeok! Let's sniff together.
Kkulddeok puts his nose to the ground. Sniff, sniff.
Sniff sniff sniff! Kkulddeok smells something.
Tap Kkulddeok! Follow the smell.
He runs off, following the smell.
Kkulddeok, wait for us!
Heave-ho, heave-ho! The three kids climb the hill.
Over the hill, there is a big chimney.
White steam puffs out of the chimney.
Tap the chimney!
The steam rolls together, and together... Pong! It turns into a cloud.
So this is where clouds come from!
Pong! Eunwoo says it too.
Tap a cloud in the sky! What will it become?
The clouds change! A rabbit, a fish, and a car.
Under the chimney, there is a big door.
What kind of factory... could this be?
Kkulddeok pokes his nose into the gap in the door.
Tap the gap in the door!
Creeeak... the door swings open.
The three kids tiptoe in after him.
Water drops fall onto a long belt. Drip, drip, drip.
Tap the water drops!
Ihyun gently touches a water drop.
Dahyun blows a big breath. Whoooo!
Tap the wind horn!
Puff, puff puff, puff puff puff! Pong!
This is a cloud factory!
Ihyun pushes the shape press. Push!
Tap the shape press, tap tap tap!
Pong! A bunny cloud. Pong! A whale cloud.
Pong! And now, a puppy cloud.
Kkulddeok touches noses with the puppy cloud.
Achoo! Little bits of cloud float away.
In the corner, there is a big red button.
Can we press it?
Tap the red button!
Eunwoo presses it. Push!
Whoosh! The puppy cloud zooms up the chimney.
Pong! Out into the sky it goes.
The next room is dark. It is the rain cloud room.
The rain clouds drink water from a big tank.
Tap the rain clouds, tap tap tap!
Gulp, gulp, gulp. Their tummies get big and round.
I think they're making rain.
Kkulddeok sniffs the wet floor.
Tap the bell!
Ding, ding, ding! The bell rings.
The rain clouds line up and go outside.
In the corner, one baby rain cloud is curled up all alone.
I don't want to go. Everybody hates rain.
How does the baby rain cloud feel right now?
It is curled up all alone. It looks sad.
Tap sad!
Kkulddeok tiptoes closer.
Eunwoo gently pats the baby rain cloud.
Pat the baby rain cloud, tap tap tap!
We love rain! We put on our boots and splash!
Splash, splash! Ihyun jumps too.
Kkulddeok licks the baby cloud's cheek. Lick!
The baby rain cloud's eyes go big and round.
Really? Then I'll go!
Tap the baby rain cloud! You can do it!
Whoosh! The baby rain cloud zooms up the chimney. Pong!
The three kids wave and run outside.
Kkulddeok looks up at the sky. Woof! Woof!
Up in the sky, the baby rain cloud bumps into a big rain cloud. Bump!
Tap the lightning!
Flash! Rumble, BOOM!
Eek! The three kids hug each other tight.
Sorry, sorry! We were just saying hello!
Kkulddeok wags his tail, wiggle wiggle.
Tap the raindrop!
It's raining!
Tap the puddles, tap tap tap! Splash, splash!
The three kids and Kkulddeok splash in the puddles!
Splash! Eunwoo jumps the highest.
Tap the ground!
Kkulddeok sniffs the strawberry.
The baby rain cloud looks down. Oh? Everyone is smiling!
A big rainbow in the sky! Wow!
Tap the rainbow... let's count all seven colors!
Tap the baby rain cloud!
After raining all its rain, the baby rain cloud turns white.
The little white cloud smiles. Pong!
So this is where clouds come from!
Kkulddeok puts his nose to the wet dirt. Sniff, sniff.
The three kids and Kkulddeok walk home the way they came.
Tap the chimney! Bye-bye!
Far away, little clouds pop out of the chimney. Pong! Pong!
Eunwoo looks back and waves. Pong!
Kkulddeok takes one last sniff of the wind from the chimney.
Plip.
Plip, plop.
Plip, plop, plop.
From the rainy ground, a little sprout pops up!
A flower opens wide!
A strawberry turns red!
Red!
Orange!
Yellow!
Green!
Blue!
Indigo!
Purple!

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 고운 콩쥐가 살았어요.
콩쥐를 톡! 눌러서 마당을 쓸어 봐요!
밭은 너무 넓어서 콩쥐는 한숨이 나왔어요.
물동이를 톡톡톡 눌러서 물을 세 번 부어 봐요!
앗! 독 밑에 구멍이 나서 물이 줄줄 새어 나왔어요.
두꺼비가 구멍에 쏙! 이제 물이 새지 않아요.
곡식이 너무 많아서 콩쥐는 걱정이 되었어요.
참새들이 콕콕 쪼아서 껍질을 벗겨 주었어요. 참새를 하나씩 세어 봐요!
참새가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 쌀이 금방 하얗게 되었어요.
이제 콩쥐는 베를 짜야 했어요. 콩쥐는 열심히 베를 짰어요.
콩쥐는 잔치에 가려고 개울을 건너기로 했어요. 징검다리를 톡! 건너 봐요!
풍덩! 꽃신 한 짝이 개울에 빠졌어요. 꽃신은 둥둥 떠내려갔어요.
콩쥐는 아쉬웠지만 한 짝만 신고 잔치로 갔어요.
잔치에서는 북과 장구와 꽹과리 소리가 울렸어요. 북을 톡 눌러 봐요!
모두 신나게 춤을 추었어요. 새엄마와 팥쥐도 곱게 차려입고 왔어요.
콩쥐를 본 새엄마와 팥쥐는 부끄러워서 부채로 얼굴을 가렸어요.
꽃신 세 켤레 중에서 나비 꽃신이 콩쥐의 꽃신이에요. 나비 꽃신을 톡!
원님이 콩쥐에게 꽃신을 신겨 주었어요. 꼭 맞았어요!
콩쥐와 원님은 혼례를 올렸어요. 콩쥐는 곱게 차린 신부가 되었어요.
모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요. 콩쥐를 톡! 모두 함께 만세!
착한 마음은 도움을 불러와요. 콩쥐팥쥐 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind girl named Kongjwi.
She lived with her stepmother and Patjwi.
Kongjwi, sweep the yard! said her stepmother.
Tap Kongjwi to sweep the yard!
The yard was clean. Kongjwi smiled.
Plow this whole field! said her stepmother.
The field was so big that Kongjwi sighed.
Then a black ox appeared. Moo! I will help you!
The ox plowed the field fast. Thank you, ox!
Fill this big jar with water! said her stepmother.
Tap the bucket, tap tap tap, to pour water three times!
Tap the bucket, tap tap tap! Pour the water.
Oh no! There was a hole in the jar, and the water leaked out.
Then a toad hopped over. I will plug the hole!
Tap the toad! Plug the hole.
The toad slipped into the hole! Now the water does not leak.
The jar was full of water. Thank you, toad!
Peel the husks and bring me the rice! said her stepmother.
There was so much grain that Kongjwi felt worried.
Then sparrows flew in. Tweet tweet! We will help!
The sparrows pecked and peeled the husks. Let's count the sparrows one by one!
Tap the sparrows, tap tap tap tap tap! Count them one by one.
One, two, three, four, five sparrows! The rice soon turned white.
Now Kongjwi had to weave cloth. She wove very hard.
Then a fairy came down from the sky. Kind Kongjwi, I have a gift for you!
Kongjwi got a beautiful dress and butterfly shoes. Thank you, fairy!
Kongjwi crossed the stream to go to the feast. Tap to cross the stepping stones!
Splash! One shoe fell into the stream and floated away.
Kongjwi felt sad, but she went to the feast with one shoe.
At the feast, drums and gongs rang out. Tap the drum!
Tap the drum! Boom boom!
Everyone danced happily. Her stepmother and Patjwi came in fancy clothes too.
When they saw Kongjwi, her stepmother and Patjwi felt shy and hid their faces behind fans.
The lost shoe reached the magistrate. Let's find who owns this shoe!
Of the three pairs of shoes, the butterfly shoe is Kongjwi's. Tap the butterfly shoe!
Tap the butterfly shoe!
Look for the shoe with butterflies on it.
Tap the sparkling shoe!
The magistrate put the shoe on Kongjwi. It fit perfectly!
Kongjwi and the magistrate got married. Kongjwi became a lovely bride.
Kongjwi, I am sorry for everything. Her stepmother and Patjwi bowed their heads.
Kongjwi smiled and said, It's okay. Let's live together.
Everyone shares rice cakes.
Everyone sat around and ate happily. Tap Kongjwi! Hooray together!
Tap Kongjwi! Hooray together!
A kind heart brings help. And that is how the story of Kongjwi and Patjwi ended.
Tap Kongjwi! Sweep the yard.
Tap Kongjwi! Cross the stepping stones.

ko.text: 나무 그늘에서 사자가 쿨쿨 낮잠을 자요.
콧방울이 퐁! 그래도 사자는 쿨쿨 자요.
작은 생쥐가 산책을 나왔어요. 풀이 숲처럼 커다래요!
화면을 톡톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝 가 볼까요?
사자가 커다란 앞발로 생쥐 꼬리를 탁! 눌렀어요.
사자가 웃다가 앞발이 스르르 열렸어요. 앞발을 톡 눌러 봐요!
사자 발과 생쥐를 나란히 놓아 볼까요?
사자 발가락 하나가 생쥐 한 마리만 해요!
더 큰 발자국을 톡 눌러 봐요!
두 발자국을 잘 봐요. 어느 쪽이 더 커다랗지?
사자가 가진 발자국이에요. 반짝이는 쪽을 눌러 봐요!
이번엔 이빨이에요. 더 작은 이빨은 어느 쪽일까요?
더 작은 이빨을 톡 눌러 봐요!
생쥐가 가진 이빨이에요. 반짝이는 쪽을 눌러 봐요!
생쥐 이빨은 작지만 아주 튼튼해요. 사각사각 뭐든 갉을 수 있지요.
좁은 구멍이 있어요. 쏙 들어갈 수 있는 건 누구일까요?
구멍에 쏙 들어갈 친구를 톡 눌러 봐요!
사자는 너무 커서 코가 쿵! 부딪혀요. 작은 친구는 누구지?
생쥐가 들어갈 수 있어요. 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
맞아요! 작은 생쥐는 좁은 구멍도 쏙!
크면 큰 대로, 작으면 작은 대로 다 쓸모가 있어요.
밤이 되었어요. 앗, 사자가 그물에 걸렸어요!
사자가 버둥버둥, 그래도 그물이 풀리지 않아요.
생쥐가 작은 이빨로 그물을 갉아요. 톡톡 눌러서 한 줄씩 끊어 봐요!
하나, 둘, 셋… 열! 그물 줄 열 개를 다 끊었어요!
"고마워, 작은 친구. 작은 이빨이 나를 구해 줬구나!"
사자랑 생쥐를 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 같이 웃어요!
그날부터 사자와 생쥐는 둘도 없는 친구가 되었답니다.
생쥐가 작은 이빨로 그물을 갉아요. 사각사각, 한 줄씩 끊어요!

en.text: The lion is taking a nap in the shade of a tree. Zzz!
Tap the lion's nose!
The nose bubble goes pop! But the lion keeps on sleeping.
A little mouse comes out for a walk. The grass is as big as a forest!
Let's tap the screen and hop along!
Tap the screen to hop!
Huh? What's this? Hop!
Wheee! The lion's mane was a great big slide. Whoosh! Hee hee!
Oh? The lion's eyes are open!
The lion pressed the mouse's tail with a big paw. Thump!
The lion yawned and said, "Haaah... shall I gobble you up in one bite?"
The mouse said, "If you let me go, I promise I'll pay you back!"
Tap the mouse to ask nicely.
Tap the mouse!
The mouse put both hands together. "Please, Lion, please!"
"You? You'll help me?"
The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened. Tap the paw!
Tap the lion's paw!
The mouse slipped right out. "Thank you, Lion!"
Let's put the lion's paw and the mouse side by side!
One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!
Which footprint is bigger?
Tap the bigger footprint!
Look at the two footprints. Which one is bigger?
That's the lion's footprint. Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! It's the lion's footprint.
Now it's teeth. Which tooth is smaller?
Tap the smaller tooth!
Look for the teeny tiny tooth, as small as a bean!
That's the mouse's tooth. Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! It's the mouse's tooth.
The mouse's teeth are small, but very strong. Nibble, nibble! They can gnaw anything.
There's a tiny hole. Who can squeeze right in?
Tap the friend who can squeeze into the hole!
The lion is too big. Bonk! Its nose bumps the hole. Who is the little friend?
The mouse can fit! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The little mouse slips right into the tiny hole!
Big or small, everyone is useful.
Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!
The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.
Ears up! The mouse heard the lion's voice.
"Lion, I'll help you!"
The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Tap, tap to cut one rope at a time!
One
Two
Three
Four
Five
Six
Seven
Eight
Nine
Ten
Tap, tap to gnaw the net!
One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!
Hooray! The lion is free!
"Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"
"Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"
The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back. "Hold tight!"
Tap, tap to run!
They race across the meadow through the wind! Yippee!
Tap the lion and the mouse. Let's laugh together!
From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.
The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened.
The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Nibble, nibble, one rope at a time!

ko.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 인어 나라가 있었어요. 바다 왕님과 할머니, 여섯 공주가 살았지요.
막내 인어공주는 조용하고 생각이 많았어요. 정원에는 배에서 떨어진 물건을 모았어요.
무거운 것은 가라앉고, 가벼운 것은 떠요. 어느 것이 바다 밑까지 내려올까요?
언니들은 열다섯 살이 되면 바다 위로 올라갔어요. 드디어 막내 차례예요!
커다란 배가 있었어요. 오늘은 왕자님 생일이래요.
밤이 깊자 바람이 세졌어요. 배가 기우뚱!
인어공주는 왕자님의 머리를 물 위로 받쳐 주었어요.
인어공주는 왕자님을 모래밭에 눕히고, 바위 뒤에 숨었어요.
왕자님은 아가씨에게 웃어 주었어요. 인어공주는 보지 못했지요.
사람은 땅 위에서 살고, 우리는 바다에서 살지. 사람에겐 별처럼 영원히 남는 마음이 있단다.
나도 왕자님 곁에서 그런 마음을 갖고 싶어요.
인어공주는 소용돌이 너머 바다 마녀를 찾아갔어요.
다리를 갖고 싶다고? 좋아. 대신 네 고운 목소리를 다오.
다리는 조금 흔들흔들할 거야. 그리고 왕자가 다른 사람과 결혼하면, 너는 바다 거품이 된단다.
마녀가 목소리를 진주처럼 가져갔어요. 이제 인어공주는 말을 할 수 없어요.
새벽, 궁전 계단에서 인어공주는 약을 마셨어요.
꼬리가 사라지고 다리가 생겼어요! 걸음은 흔들흔들.
인어공주는 말을 못 해요. 그저 웃었지요.
정원에 바다 친구가 섞였네. 바다에 사는 친구를 찾아봐요.
바다에서 온 아이 같아요. 내 귀여운 동생처럼 지내요.
당신이 모래밭에서 저를 구해 준 분이군요!
왕자님은 이웃 나라 공주님과 결혼했어요. 인어공주는 말없이 웃었어요. 마음은 아팠지요.
새벽, 배 옆에 언니들이 올라왔어요. 긴 머리가 짧아졌어요.
인어공주는 잠든 왕자님과 공주님을 보았어요. 그리고 고개를 저었지요.
인어공주는 단검을 칼집째 바다에 던졌어요. 물결이 붉은 금빛으로 반짝였어요. 해가 떠올랐어요.
인어공주는 반짝이는 거품이 되어 하늘로 둥실 올라갔어요.
인어공주는 부드러운 바닷바람이 되었어요. 길 잃은 배의 돛을 밀어 주고, 더운 날엔 시원한 바람을 보내지요.
사랑하는 마음은 사라지지 않아요. 안녕, 또 만나요!
사랑하는 마음으로 양보하면, 그 마음은 좋은 일이 되어 남아요.

en.text: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.
The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.
Heavy things sink, and light things float. Which one will come all the way down to the sea floor?
The piece of wood is light, so it floats.
The heavy stone sank!
This time, which one will sink?
The cork bottle is light, so it floats.
The heavy anchor sank too!
When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!
Be careful, and come back safely.
Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!
There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.
Tap the sky!
Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.
So that is the prince.
Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!
The prince fell into the sea.
I will help you!
The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.
The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.
Oh my, are you all right?
The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.
The prince is awake. I am so glad.
Grandmother, how do people live?
People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.
I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.
The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.
You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.
Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.
I will go anyway.
Tap the cauldron!
The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.
At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.
Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.
Who are you? Where did you come from?
The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.
Come and stay at our palace.
Some sea friends got mixed into the garden. Let's find the friends that live in the sea.
Which friend lives in the sea?
The fish lives in the sea!
The shell lives in the sea!
The starfish lives in the sea!
The butterfly flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
The rabbit hops on the land. It is a land friend.
The flower blooms on the land. It is a land friend.
The bird flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
The tree grows on the land. It is a land friend.
The puppy runs on the land. It is a land friend.
You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.
Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.
You are the one who saved me on the beach!
The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.
At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.
The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.
The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.
The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.
The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.
Tap the bubble light to say hello!
A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!
When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 농부가 살았어요.
농부는 밭을 열심히 갈았어요. 농부를 톡! 눌러서 밭을 갈아 봐요!
쨍! 괭이 끝에 뭔가 딱딱한 게 닿았어요.
쑥! 커다란 항아리가 나왔어요. 농부는 눈이 동그래졌어요.
농부는 항아리를 집 마당에 놓았어요. 아내도 구경하러 나왔어요.
농부가 괭이를 항아리 옆에 두려다 그만 항아리 속에 떨어뜨렸어요.
항아리를 톡톡톡 눌러서 괭이가 몇 개 나오는지 세어 봐요!
괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
이번에는 엽전 하나를 넣어 봤어요. 와르르! 엽전이 쏟아져 나왔어요.
항아리를 톡톡톡톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 다섯 개 세어 봐요!
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
착한 농부는 혼자만 쓰지 않았어요. 이웃 다섯 집에 쌀을 나눠 주러 갔어요.
다섯 집 모두 쌀을 받고 활짝 웃었어요. 마을이 함께 행복해졌어요.
부자를 톡! 금 더미에서 꺼내 줘요.
풍덩! 아버지가 항아리에 거꾸로 쏙 빠졌어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
아버지가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 여덟 명이나 되었어요.
쨍그랑! 항아리가 깨지자 일곱 명은 사라지고, 진짜 아버지만 남았어요.
부자는 농부를 찾아가 사과하고, 가진 것을 마을 사람들과 나누기로 했어요. 함께 잔치를 열어요!
나누면 기쁨이 커져요. 요술 항아리 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.
The farmer worked hard in his field. Tap the farmer to dig!
Clang! The hoe hit something hard.
A round lid is showing in the ground.
Pop! A big jar came out. The farmer's eyes went wide.
The farmer put the jar in his yard. His wife came out to look, too.
The farmer tried to put his hoe beside the jar, but it fell inside.
Oh my! There are two hoes now! His wife was so surprised.
Tap, tap, tap the jar and count how many hoes come out!
Tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the hoes.
One, two, three hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.
Tap the jar five times and count five coins!
Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.
Tap a house! Share the rice.
All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.
A rich man heard the news and called the farmer. Lend me that jar!
x
Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee. The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.
The rich man put the jar in his room. If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!
Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold. Help me!
Tap the rich man to pull him out.
Tap the rich man! Pull him out of the gold.
Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.
Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar. What is this?
Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.
Where is Father? Tap, tap, tap the jar and count the fathers!
Tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the fathers.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.
I am the real father! No, I am the real one! Each one insisted he was the real father.
I am hungry! Give me food! The rich man ran around with a tray.
The rich man was worn out and shouted. It is all because of this jar! Stop!
Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.
Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.
The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!
Thank you, everyone! They all sat together and ate happily.
Tap the farmer! Hooray, everyone!
Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
Tap the farmer! Dig with the hoe.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 마음씨 고운 선비가 과거를 보러 먼 길을 떠났어요.
저벅저벅. 산 넘고 물 건너, 선비는 깊은 산속으로 들어갔어요.
큰 소나무 위 둥지에 아기 까치들이 있어요. 그런데 구렁이가 스르르 올라가고 있어요!
안 돼! 내가 아기 까치들을 지켜 줄게.
선비가 활을 꺼냈어요. 선비를 톡 눌러 봐요.
쉬익, 탁! 화살이 구렁이 바로 옆 나무에 꽂혔어요.
깜짝 놀란 구렁이는 스르르 숲으로 달아났어요.
둥지 안에서 아기 까치들이 고개를 쏙 내밀었어요.
아기 까치가 몇 마리일까요? 맞는 숫자를 골라요.
선비는 빙긋 웃으며 다시 길을 떠났어요.
오늘 밤은 어디서 자지? …어, 저기 불빛이!
깊은 산속 외딴집에서 한 여인이 나왔어요.
어서 오세요, 나그네님. 하룻밤 쉬어 가세요.
선비는 따뜻한 방에서 금세 잠이 들었어요.
한밤중, 선비는 으스스한 기운에 눈을 떴어요.
문 앞에 그 여인이 서 있었어요. 그런데… 치마 밑으로 꼬리가 삐죽!
나는 낮에 네가 활로 쫓아낸, 그 구렁이의 아내다.
내 남편을 놀라게 한 벌로, 너를 이대로 보내 줄 수는 없어.
저는 그저 아기 까치들을 지키려 했을 뿐이에요. 제발 보내 주세요.
좋아. 새벽이 오기 전에 저 산 위 절의 종이 세 번 울리면, 너를 놓아주마.
하지만 이 깊은 밤에, 누가 종을 치겠니? 후후…
그때, 큰 소나무 둥지의 까치 가족은 잠들지 못하고 있었어요.
여보, 선비님이 큰일 났어요! 외딴집의 구렁이 아내가…
종! 절의 종을 울리면 돼요. 우리가 날아가요!
까치 엄마 아빠와 숲속 까치 친구들이 밤하늘로 날아올랐어요.
달빛을 가르며, 산 위 절을 향해 쌩쌩!
절은 고요했어요. 커다란 종이 달빛 아래 걸려 있었어요.
종을 쳐야 해. 우리 머리로, 온 힘을 다해!
댕—. 깊고 큰 종소리가 산을 넘어 퍼져 갔어요.
까치들은 온 힘을 다해 종을 울렸어요.
그리고 힘이 다 빠진 까치들은, 종 아래에 스르르 쓰러져 잠이 들었어요.
여인은 스르르 구렁이로 변하더니, 새벽 숲으로 사라졌어요.
종소리… 누가 종을 울렸을까? 가 봐야겠어!
종 아래에, 까치 엄마 아빠가 눈을 감은 채 누워 있었어요.
선비는 까치들을 품에 안고, 시원한 물을 한 모금씩 먹여 주었어요.
그때 아기 까치들이 짹짹 울며 날아왔어요.
고마워, 까치들아. 너희 마음, 평생 잊지 않을게.
은혜를 잊지 않고 갚는 마음은, 이렇게 따뜻해요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a kind young scholar set off on a long journey to take the royal exam.
Step, step. Over hills and across streams, the scholar walked deep into the mountains.
Caw, caw! Please help us!
High in the big pine tree was a nest of baby magpies. And a big snake was slithering up toward it!
Oh no! I will keep the baby magpies safe.
The scholar took out his bow. Tap the scholar.
Whoosh, thunk! The arrow struck the tree right beside the snake.
The startled snake slithered away into the forest.
Thank you, kind scholar! We will repay your kindness, we promise.
The baby magpies popped their heads up out of the nest.
How many baby magpies are there? Pick the right number.
That card says one. Let's count again.
That card says two. Let's count again.
That card says three. Let's count again.
That card says four. Let's count again.
That card says five. Let's count again.
That's right! One baby magpie.
That's right! Two baby magpies.
That's right! Three baby magpies.
That's right! Four baby magpies.
That's right! Five baby magpies.
Chirp chirp! Thank you, scholar!
The scholar smiled and went on his way.
Soon the sun went down, and the mountain path grew dark.
Where will I sleep tonight? ...Oh, a light over there!
A woman came out of a lonely house deep in the mountains.
Welcome, traveler. Come in and rest for the night.
Thank you. Just for one night, if I may.
In the warm room, the scholar soon fell asleep.
In the middle of the night, the scholar woke with a shiver.
The woman was standing by the door. But... a tail was peeking out from under her skirt!
I am the wife of the snake you chased away with your arrow today.
You frightened my husband. I cannot let you go just like that.
I only wanted to protect the baby magpies. Please, let me go.
Very well. If the temple bell on the mountain rings three times before dawn, I will let you go.
But in the deep of night, who would ring the bell? Hmm hmm...
The bell... the bell has to ring. What can I do...
Meanwhile, in the nest in the big pine tree, the magpie family could not sleep.
Dear, the scholar is in danger! The snake's wife at the lonely house...
The bell! We just have to ring the temple bell. Let's fly!
Little ones, wait right here in the nest.
Mama and Papa Magpie and their magpie friends rose into the night sky.
Through the moonlight, swish, swish, toward the temple on the mountain!
The temple was silent. A great bell hung in the moonlight.
We must strike the bell. With our heads, with all our might!
Tap the bell.
Dong... The deep, great sound of the bell rolled over the mountains.
Dong... The second ring.
Dong... The third ring sounded.
The magpies had rung the bell with all their might.
And then, with no strength left, the magpies sank down beneath the bell and fell asleep.
From far away came the sound of the bell.
The bell... it rang. One, two, three.
A promise is a promise. I will let you go.
The woman turned back into a snake and slipped away into the dawn forest.
The bell... who could have rung it? I must go and see!
The scholar ran up to the temple on the mountain.
Beneath the bell, Mama and Papa Magpie lay with their eyes closed.
Magpies... it was you. You did this to save me...
The scholar held the magpies gently and gave them each a sip of cool water.
Scholar... you are safe.
We have repaid your kindness. That is enough.
Just then, the baby magpies came flying, chirping all the way.
Mama! Papa!
Tap the scholar.
Thank you, magpies. I will never forget what you did for me.
A heart that remembers kindness and gives it back is as warm as this.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 깊은 산골에 팥죽을 아주 잘 쑤는 할멈이 살았어요.
드디어 동짓날이 되었어요. 할멈은 팥죽을 쑤면서 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 어흥! 호랑이가 어슬렁어슬렁 찾아왔어요!
알밤이 아궁이에서 톡! 튀어나와 호랑이 눈을 딱 때렸어요!
알밤이 톡 튀어나왔지만, 호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 없었어요!
물독 속 자라가 호랑이 입을 앙! 물었어요!
자라가 물독에서 두리번두리번… 호랑이 얼굴이 없네요!
송곳이 콕! 찔렀지만, 호랑이는 저쪽에 있네요.
절구가 문 위에서 쿵! 호랑이 머리 위로 떨어졌어요!
절구가 쿵! 떨어졌지만 호랑이를 못 맞혔어요!
지게가 호랑이를 번쩍 지고 가서 바다에 풍덩! 던져 버렸어요!
지게가 낑낑… 힘센 호랑이를 들 수가 없어요!
미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 이번엔 누구일까요?
쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요. 이제 누구 차례죠?
돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 마지막은 누구일까요?
만세! 호랑이를 물리쳤어요! 할멈은 친구들과 맛있는 팥죽을 나누어 먹었답니다.
호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 있어요. 아궁이 속에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 물독에 얼굴을 넣었어요. 물독 속에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 부엌 바닥으로 뒷걸음질! 바닥에 납작 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이가 바닥에 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이는 문 앞에 있어요. 문 위에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 마당에 쭉 뻗었어요. 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 담벼락에 기대 숨은 친구는 누구지?

en.text: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.
Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared. Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!
Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then. The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.
At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.
It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!
Friends, help me! Tap your friends, one after another, to give that tiger a lesson!
Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in. Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you! Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.
Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
Chestnut popped out — pop! — but the tiger wasn't by the fireplace!
Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.
Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!
Turtle peeked out of the water jar, looking this way and that... no tiger face in sight!
Splat! Cow Plop arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.
The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!
The tiger hopped right over Cow Plop!
Poke, poke! Awl arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.
Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!
Awl poked — poke! — but the tiger was over there.
Thump-a-thump! Mortar arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.
Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!
Mortar fell — thump! — but missed the tiger!
Flap, flap! Straw Mat arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.
Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!
Straw Mat flapped and flapped... and didn't roll up a thing!
Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.
Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!
Carrier groaned and strained... the strong tiger was too heavy to lift!
Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me. At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace. Who should teach the tiger a lesson first?
Ow, hot! My eyes! The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes. Who's next?
Yowch! The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward. Who's next?
Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor! Who is it this time?
Boo-hoo, that hurts! The tiger ran away toward the door. Who's next?
Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat. Whose turn is it now?
Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who's last?
Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.
Tap, and say hello to your friends!
The tiger is by the fireplace. Who is hiding inside the fireplace?
Tap Chestnut!
The tiger dunked its face in the water jar. Who is hiding in the water jar?
Tap Turtle!
The tiger is backing up onto the kitchen floor! Who is hiding flat on the floor?
Tap Cow Plop!
The tiger fell flat on the floor. Who is hiding, all pointy, in a crack in the floor?
Tap Awl!
The tiger is by the door. Who is hiding above the door?
Tap Mortar!
The tiger is stretched out in the yard. Who is hiding, rolled up, in the yard?
Tap Straw Mat!
The tiger is rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who is hiding against the wall?
Tap Carrier!

ko.text: 옛날에 진짜 공주와 결혼하고 싶은 왕자가 있었어요.
왕자는 배를 타고 온 세상을 돌아다녔어요.
온 세상을 다 가 봤지만, 진짜 공주인지 알 수 없었어요.
그날 밤, 비가 쏟아지고 천둥이 우르릉!
비를 맞았지만 괜찮아요. 저는 진짜 공주예요!
왕비님은 손님방에 완두콩 한 알, 베개, 매트리스 한 장을 가져왔어요.
셋 중에서 제일 작은 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
그건 베개예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
그건 매트리스예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
그럼 제일 큰 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
그건 완두콩이에요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
그건 베개예요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
요 조그만 완두콩 한 알을 침대 판자에 톡. 아무도 못 본 척!
완두콩 위에 매트리스를 쌓아 볼까? 몇 장일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
열! 아직 더 있어요. 한 번 더 톡!
완두콩은 어디 있을까요? 탑의 위? 아래?
거긴 탑의 위예요. 완두콩은 맨 아래에 있어요. 아래를 눌러 봐요.
거긴 탑의 아래예요. 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요. 위를 눌러 봐요.
완두콩은 맨 아래, 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요.
밤이 깊었는데… 공주는 이리 뒤척, 저리 뒤척.
뭔가 딱딱한 게 있는 것 같아…
아니요, 솔직히 한숨도 못 잤어요. 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있어서 몸이 뻐근하고 졸려요.
매트리스 스무 장 아래 완두콩을 느끼다니! 진짜 공주로구나!

en.text: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.
Tap the boat.
The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.
I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.
That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!
Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.
Tap the gate.
Who could it be at this hour?
I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!
Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.
A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.
The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.
Which of the three is the smallest? Tap it.
That's the pillow. Look for something smaller.
That's the mattress. Look for something smaller.
That's right, the pea is the smallest!
Then which one is the biggest? Tap it.
That's the pea. Look for something bigger.
That's the pillow. Look for something bigger.
That's right, the mattress is the biggest!
This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!
Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea? How many will there be? Tap!
Ten! And there are still more. Tap once more!
Twenty! That makes twenty mattresses.
And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!
Where is the pea? At the top of the tower, or at the bottom?
That's the top of the tower. The pea is at the very bottom. Tap the bottom.
That's right! The pea is at the very bottom.
Where will the princess sleep? At the top, or at the bottom?
That's the bottom of the tower. The princess sleeps at the very top. Tap the top.
That's right! The princess sleeps at the very top.
The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.
Wow, it's so high! Good night.
Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.
I think there's something hard in here...
Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.
Did you sleep well?
No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.
She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!
The prince and the princess held hands tight.
At last, I have found a true princess!
And the pea was sent to a museum.
Tap the glass case.
Bye-bye!

ko.text: 문을 톡 두드려 봐요. 누가 나올까?
누구 목소리일까요? 둘 중에서 골라 봐요!
친구들을 모두 톡톡 눌러 봐요! 벌떡 일어나 응원해요.
아직 안 일어난 친구를 톡 눌러 봐요!
토끼는 쌩~ 거북이는 엉금 한 발!
여기는 경주 지도예요. 돌멩이, 개울, 언덕을 지나 깃발까지!
아래 막대를 보면 누가 앞서는지 알 수 있어요.
토끼는 쌩쌩 달려요! 화면을 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
금세 언덕 위 나무 그늘까지 왔어요.
부엉이가 자장가를 불러 줘요. 잘 들어 봐요.
이번에는 부엉이를 톡 눌러 봐요. 자장가가 이어져요!
나무 위 부엉이를 톡 눌러 봐요!
부엉 부엉~ 토끼 눈이 스르르 감겨요.
마지막으로 해님을 톡! 구름이 해를 가려 줘요.
상으로 커다란 당근을 받았어요. 당근을 톡!
하지만 진짜 토끼는 나무 아래에서 드르렁 쿨쿨~
화면을 톡톡 눌러서 한 발 한 발 걸어요!
어? 커다란 돌멩이예요! 돌멩이를 톡 해서 넘어가요!
앗, 개울이에요! 거북이는 헤엄을 잘 쳐요.
위에는 쿨쿨 자는 토끼, 아래에는 거북이!
닭을 톡 눌러서 토끼를 깨워 줄까요?
토끼가 쌩쌩 달려와요! 거북이는 딱 한 발 남았어요.
거북이를 톡 눌러서 마지막 한 발!
사진을 보니… 거북이 코끝이 먼저 닿았어요!
메달을 톡! 거북이 목에 걸어 줘요.
"축하해! 다음엔 나도 쉬지 않고 열심히 할게."
이번에는 친구들을 톡톡 눌러서 같이 연주해요!
천천히 가도 끝까지 하면 해낼 수 있어요!
화면을 톡! 한 발 한 발 걸어요.

en.text: Morning has come to the forest village.
The turtle is plodding along on a walk. Tap the turtle!
Tap the turtle!
"Hi! I'm Turtle."
The hop-hop rabbit is here too. Tap the rabbit!
Tap the rabbit!
"Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!"
The rabbit said, "Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?"
The turtle gave a big smile. "Okay!"
"Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!"
The owl mail carrier brought the invitations.
Tap the door to knock. Who will come out?
Tap the next door too!
Tap the door to knock!
Whose voice is it? Pick one of the two!
Did you hear that? Whose voice was it?
It's the duck! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the duck!
It's the cow! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the cow!
It's the pig! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the pig!
It's the puppy! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the puppy!
The rooster, the sheep, and the cat got invitations too!
The animal friends gathered to cheer!
Tap all the friends! They'll jump up and cheer.
Tap a friend who hasn't stood up yet!
Wow, what a happy cheer!
Before the race, let's do warm-up exercises.
Tap the rabbit! Stretch those ears~
One more time! Tap the rabbit!
Now tap the turtle! Stretch that neck~
Tap the turtle too!
Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!
The raccoon referee brought a big drum.
Ready~ Tap the drum and they're off!
Tap the big drum!
The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!
This is the race map. Past the rocks, the stream, and the hill, all the way to the flag!
Look at the bar below to see who is ahead.
The rabbit zooms along! Tap the screen again and again!
Tap the screen again and again!
Soon the rabbit reached the shady tree on the hill.
Looking back... no turtle in sight!
"Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~"
Shall we help the rabbit sleep tight?
First, tap the leaf blanket!
Tap the leaf blanket!
Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.
The owl sings a lullaby. Listen carefully.
Now tap the owl. The lullaby keeps going!
Tap the owl in the tree!
Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.
Last, tap the sun! A cloud covers the sun.
Tap the sun!
The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.
The cheering friends whisper, "Shh!" Quiet now~
The rabbit is dreaming. In the dream, the rabbit came in first!
As a prize, the rabbit got a giant carrot. Tap the carrot!
Tap the giant carrot!
"Crunch! Mmm, yummy!"
But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~
Meanwhile, what about the turtle? Plod, plod, walking along.
Tap the screen to take one step at a time!
Tap the screen to plod along!
Oh! A big rock! Tap the rock to climb over it!
Tap the rock!
Heave-ho! The turtle made it over the rock!
Oh, a stream! The turtle is a good swimmer.
Tap the screen to swim!
The turtle crossed the stream with the fish!
Now there's a tall hill.
Tap the screen and up you go, heave-ho, heave-ho!
Heave-ho! The turtle reached the top of the hill.
Up above, the rabbit sleeps. Down below, the turtle!
Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.
Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!
The sun is slowly setting.
Shall we tap the rooster to wake the rabbit?
Tap the rooster!
The rabbit jumped right up! "Oh no, I fell asleep!"
Look at the bar! The turtle is almost at the finish line!
All the cheering friends stood up!
The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.
Tap the turtle! One last step!
Tap the turtle for one last step!
Look at the photo... the turtle's nose touched first!
The turtle is number one!
It's the award ceremony! The cheering friends do the wave.
Tap the medal! Hang it around the turtle's neck.
Tap the sparkly medal!
Sparkle, sparkle, a gold medal!
The rabbit came over and said,
"Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest."
The turtle said, "Thank you! Let's race together again!"
Night came. The forest party began!
Listen first! It's a lively march.
Now tap the friends to play along together!
Everyone had a happy party together.
Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
The turtle takes a slow, slow walk.
Hop, hop! Here comes the rabbit too.
All the friends jump up and cheer!
The rabbit stretches its ears, up, up!
The turtle stretches its neck, long, long!
Tap the screen! One step at a time.
Tap the screen! Swim, swim.
Tap the screen! Heave-ho, up we go.
Tap the screen!

ko.text: 옛날에 아기를 기다리는 부부가 살았어요. 아기가 곧 올 거예요.
담 너머 텃밭은 마녀 고텔의 마법 텃밭이라 아무도 들어가지 못했어요.
저 라푼젤 풀이 너무너무 먹고 싶어요.
밤이 되자, 아버지는 살금살금 담을 넘었어요.
아, 아내가 너무너무 먹고 싶어 해서요.
내 풀을 가져가도 좋다. 대신 아기가 태어나면 내가 키우마.
아기가 태어났어요. 마녀 고텔은 아기를 데려가 라푼젤이라고 이름 짓고 정성껏 키웠어요.
라푼젤이 열두 살이 되자, 마녀는 지팡이를 톡 두드렸어요.
숲속에 문도 계단도 없는 높은 탑이 쑥 솟았어요. 창문은 꼭대기에 하나뿐이에요.
자, 잠겨라. 밖은 위험하단다. 여기가 제일 안전해.
지붕 위에는 새 한 마리, 탑 아래에는 토끼 한 마리가 있어요.
탑 위에 있는 새를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
그건 탑 아래에 있는 토끼예요. 위를 봐요.
이번엔 탑 아래에 있는 토끼를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
그건 탑 위에 있는 새예요. 아래를 봐요.
스르르~ 금빛 머리가 탑 아래까지 닿았어요.
라푼젤은 혼자 있을 때면 창가에서 노래를 불렀어요.
바닥에 리본 세 개가 있어요. 길이가 다 달라요.
라푼젤 머리를 묶을 제일 긴 리본을 찾아봐요.
그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
그건 제일 짧은 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
그럼 제일 짧은 리본은 어디 있을까요?
그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 짧은 리본이 있어요.
라푼젤은 리본을 묶은 머리를 창가에 늘어뜨리고 또 노래했어요.
어느 해질녘, 숲을 지나던 왕자가 노랫소리를 들었어요.
왕자는 탑을 한 바퀴 돌았지만 문이 없었어요.
그때 마녀 고텔이 왔어요. 왕자는 나무 뒤에 숨었어요.
다음 날 저녁, 왕자는 탑 아래에서 외쳤어요.
놀라게 해서 미안해요. 노래가 너무 고와서 왔어요. 저와 함께 성으로 가요.
할머니, 할머니는 왜 왕자님보다 훨씬 무거워요?
마녀는 가위 한 번으로 라푼젤의 머리를 자르고, 지팡이를 톡 두드려 먼 들판의 작은 오두막으로 데려갔어요.
그날 저녁, 왕자는 아무것도 모르고 탑에 왔어요.
마녀는 잘린 머리를 고리에 걸어 내려 주었어요.
라푼젤은 여기 없다. 다시는 못 볼 거다. 자, 내려가라.
휘익~ 마법 바람이 왕자를 탑 아래 풀숲에 사뿐 내려놓았어요.
왕자는 슬픈 얼굴로 숲을 걷고 또 걸었어요.
포기하지 않길 잘했어요. 이제 함께 가요.
두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 성으로 떠났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a husband and wife who were waiting for a baby. The baby was coming soon.
Beyond the wall was the magic garden of the witch Gothel, and no one was allowed in.
Oh, I want to eat that rampion so, so much.
I'll go and get some for you.
When night came, the father quietly climbed over the wall.
Who's there! Pulling up my rampion!
Oh! My wife wanted it so, so much.
You may take my rampion. But when the baby is born, I shall raise it.
Yes... all right.
The baby was born. The witch Gothel took her away, named her Rapunzel, and raised her with care.
When Rapunzel turned twelve, the witch tapped her stick on the ground.
Up rose a tall tower in the forest, with no door and no stairs. There was only one window, right at the top.
Now, lock tight. The outside is dangerous. This is the safest place.
On top of the roof sits a bird, and down below the tower sits a rabbit.
Tap the bird on top of the tower.
That's the rabbit below the tower. Look up.
That's right, the bird on top!
Now tap the rabbit below the tower.
That's the bird on top of the tower. Look down.
That's right, the rabbit below!
Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
Swish... the golden hair slid all the way down to the foot of the tower.
Gothel took hold of the hair and slowly climbed up.
Whenever Rapunzel was alone, she sang at the window.
I wish my song could reach the end of the forest.
There are three ribbons on the floor. They are all different lengths.
Find the longest ribbon to tie Rapunzel's hair.
That's the middle ribbon. There's a longer one.
That's the shortest ribbon. There's a longer one.
That's right, the longest ribbon!
Now, where is the shortest ribbon?
That's the middle ribbon. There's a shorter one.
That's right, the shortest ribbon!
Rapunzel let her ribboned hair hang at the window and sang again.
One evening at sunset, a prince riding through the forest heard the singing.
Where is that lovely song coming from?
The prince walked all the way around the tower, but there was no door.
Just then the witch Gothel came. The prince hid behind a tree.
Ah, so that's how you get up there!
The next evening, the prince called out from the foot of the tower.
Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
Oh my, you're not Grandmother?
I'm sorry I startled you. Your song was so lovely that I came. Come with me to my castle.
All right. If you bring me silk thread, I'll weave a ladder.
From that day on, the prince brought silk thread every evening.
One day, Rapunzel said without thinking,
Grandmother, why are you so much heavier than the prince?
What? A prince!
With one snip of her scissors the witch cut off Rapunzel's hair, then tapped her stick and took her away to a little cottage in a faraway meadow.
That evening, the prince came to the tower, knowing nothing.
The witch hung the cut-off braid on the hook and let it down.
Rapunzel is not here. You will never see her again. Now, down you go.
Whoosh... a magic wind set the prince gently down in the grass below the tower.
Rapunzel... where could she be?
The prince walked and walked through the forest with a sad face.
Then, carried on the wind, came the sound of singing.
That song... Rapunzel!
Prince! You came and found me.
I'm glad I never gave up. Let's go together now.
The two held hands tightly and set off for the castle.
And the witch Gothel went back to her garden.

ko.text: 그건 파란 블록이에요. 빨간 것을 찾아봐요.
그건 노란 오리예요. 빨간 것을 찾아봐요.
밥 먹을 때도 냠냠, 잠잘 때도 쌔근, 언제나 손에 꼭 쥐고 있었지요.
그러던 어느 날, 밖에서 놀고 있었어요.
노느라 그만 빨간 자동차를 톡, 놓고 말았어요.
정신을 차려 보니… 어라? 빨간 자동차가 보이지 않아요!
잉잉, 내 빨간 자동차 어디 갔지?
홀로 남은 빨간 자동차는 이현이를 찾기로 했어요. 용기 있게 출발!
부릉부릉! 이현이를 찾아 장난감 세상으로 가자!
조금 가다 보니, 삐뽀삐뽀 우렁찬 소리가 들렸어요.
경찰차 장난감이 도둑 장난감들을 쫓아 씽씽 달리고 있었어요.
어? 너는 이현이가 잃어버렸던 경찰차 형아?!
좋아! 도둑을 다 잡았으니 같이 가자!
가다 보니 이번엔 위이잉, 소리가 났어요.
소방차가 블록으로 만든 장난감 집에 난 불을 쉭쉭 끄고 있었어요.
어? 소방차 이모! 우리 같이 이현이 만나러 가요!
그래그래! 불을 다 껐으니 같이 가자!
셋이서 길을 가다 보니 삐용삐용, 바쁜 소리가 들렸어요.
구급차 삼촌이 아픈 인형들을 태우고 병원으로 가고 있었지요.
구급차 삼촌! 우리랑 같이 이현이한테 가요!
오냐오냐, 아픈 친구들을 다 데려다주었으니 이제 이현이에게 가자!
넷이서 나란히 달려요. 친구들이 소리로 인사했어요.
