하지만 너무 오래 달린 빨간 자동차는 그만 툭, 멈춰 서고 말았어요.
그때, 저 멀리서 덜컹덜컹 든든한 소리가 들렸어요.
바로 이현이가 전에 잃어버렸던 주황색 견인차였어요!
견인차가 튼튼한 고리로 빨간 자동차를 찰칵! 걸어 주었어요.
견인차가 빨간 자동차를 앞에서 끌고, 그 뒤로 경찰차, 소방차, 구급차가 든든하게 따랐어요.
맨 앞에서 끌어 주는 건 누구일까요? 골라 봐요.
그건 빨간 자동차예요. 맨 앞을 다시 봐요.
그건 경찰차 형아예요. 맨 앞을 다시 봐요.
그건 소방차 이모예요. 맨 앞을 다시 봐요.
그건 구급차 삼촌이에요. 맨 앞을 다시 봐요.
긴 기차처럼 한 줄로 칙칙폭폭, 붕붕붕!
경찰차랑 소방차, 구급차랑 견인차도 다 여기 있네!
이현이는 소중한 보물 자동차들을 모두 품에 안고 펄쩍펄쩍 기뻐했답니다.

en.text: Ihyun loved the little red car very much.
Where is the red one? Find it!
That's the blue block. Find the red one.
That's the yellow duck. Find the red one.
That's right, the red car!
Munch munch at mealtime, snore snore at bedtime, the red car was always in Ihyun's hand.
Then one day, Ihyun was playing outside.
Oh! A butterfly!
Ihyun was so busy playing that the red car slipped out, plop, onto the grass.
And then... huh? The red car was nowhere to be seen!
Boo-hoo, where did my red car go?
The little red car, all alone, decided to go and find Ihyun. Off it went, brave and bold!
Vroom vroom! Let's go to Toy Land and find Ihyun!
A little way down the road, there came a loud wee-woo, wee-woo!
Stop right there!
A toy police car was zooming after some toy robbers.
Huh? You're the police car Ihyun lost! Big brother police car!
Let's go find Ihyun together!
Sure! I've caught all the robbers, so let's go together!
Big brother police car led the way.
A little farther on, there came a wee-ooo sound.
Stand back! I'm putting out the fire!
A fire truck was spraying water, whoosh whoosh, on a fire at a little block house.
Oh? Auntie fire truck! Come with us to find Ihyun!
Of course! The fire is out, so let's go together!
Auntie fire truck happily joined the group.
As the three drove on, there came a busy nee-naw, nee-naw!
Uncle ambulance was taking some sick dolls to the hospital.
Uncle ambulance! Come with us to find Ihyun!
All right, all right! I've brought the sick friends to the hospital, so now let's go to Ihyun!
Uncle ambulance came along too, strong and steady.
The four friends drove side by side. They said hello with their sounds.
Come on, everyone, let's go to Ihyun!
But the little red car had driven for so long that it stopped with a clunk.
Oh dear, I'm so tired. I can't go any farther...
Its wheels felt so heavy it couldn't move at all.
Just then, from far away, came a sturdy clatter, clatter sound.
Don't worry! I'll help you!
It was the orange tow truck Ihyun had lost long ago!
The tow truck hooked its strong hook onto the red car. Click!
Heave-ho, heave-ho!
The tow truck pulled the red car from the front, and behind them came the police car, the fire truck and the ambulance.
Who is pulling at the very front? Pick one!
That's the red car. Look at the very front again.
That's big brother police car. Look at the very front again.
That's auntie fire truck. Look at the very front again.
That's uncle ambulance. Look at the very front again.
That's right, the tow truck!
Like a long train, all in a row: chugga-chugga, vroom vroom vroom!
At last, they found Ihyun at the playground!
Wow! My red car!
And the police car, the fire truck, the ambulance and the tow truck are all here too!
Ihyun hugged all the precious toy cars and jumped for joy.
Now let's all go home together!

ko.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자를 머리에 씌워 주었어요. 빨간 모자가 한 번 빙글 돌았어요.
"길에서 벗어나면 안 돼. 모르는 사람과 이야기하지도 마."
빨간 모자는 콧노래를 부르며 숲길을 걸어요.
어, 나무 뒤에서 뭔가 보슬보슬한 게 살짝 보였어요. 꼬리였나 봐요!
"꽃을 따 가면 할머니가 참 좋아하실 텐데~"
꽃밭에 알록달록 꽃이 가득해요. 꽃을 같은 색 꽃병에 쏙쏙 담아요!
꽃병마다 꽃다발이 활짝! 빨간 모자는 꽃을 따느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
위에서는 빨간 모자가 꽃을 따요. 아래에서는 늑대가 지름길로 달려가요!
늑대는 할머니의 잠옷을 입고 침대에 누웠어요.
빨간 모자는 숲속 할머니 집에 도착했어요. 문을 톡 두드려요!
벽에 걸린 진짜 할머니 사진과 비교해서 다른 곳을 찾아봐요!
빨간 모자는 고개를 갸웃했어요. 또 이상한 곳이 있나 봐요.
빨간 모자는 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이 사람은 할머니가 아니에요!
늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요! 빨간 모자야, 어서 숨어요! 옷장을 톡!
빨간 모자는 옷장 속으로 쏙! 늑대는 두리번두리번 찾았지만 보이지 않았어요.
할머니를 먹어서 배가 불렀던 늑대는 스르르 눈이 감겼어요. 쿨쿨…
창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요. 창문을 톡톡 두드려 봐요!
늑대가 딸꾹! 하자 할머니가 퐁! 하고 튀어나왔어요. 할머니는 다치지 않고 멀쩡했어요!
할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요. 바구니 속 간식을 한 가지씩 나눠 줘요!
"이제 약속을 꼭 지킬게요. 길에서 벗어나지 않고, 모르는 사람과는 이야기하지 않을래요."
빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸고, 오늘 일을 오래오래 기억했어요.
빨간 모자를 톡톡톡! 한 걸음씩 걸어가요.
꽃이랑 색깔이 같은 꽃병이 어디 있을까?
사진 속 할머니와 달라 보이는 곳을 톡!
간식을 톡! 한 사람씩 나눠 줘요.
빨간 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
빨간 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
노란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
노란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
파란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
파란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!

en.text: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood. Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.
Put the bread, milk, and apple in the basket!
Three! The basket is full.
Mother put the red hood on her head. Red Hood spun around once.
Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.
Yes, Mother! I promise.
Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.
Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path.
Oh, something fluffy peeked out from behind a tree. It must be a tail!
The wolf slipped out from beside a tree. Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?
I'm going to Grandmother's house. Red Hood answered.
Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~
What a good idea! Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.
The flower field is full of colorful flowers. Put each flower in the vase of the same color!
Bouquets in every vase! Red Hood was so busy picking flowers, she lost track of time.
Up above, Red Hood picks flowers. Down below, the wolf runs along the shortcut!
Knock, knock, knock... the door closes... gulp!
The wolf put on Grandmother's nightgown and lay down in her bed.
Red Hood arrived at Grandmother's house in the forest. Tap to knock on the door!
Come in~ A hoarse voice came from inside.
Grandmother, are you here? But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.
Compare with the real Grandmother's picture on the wall and find what is different!
Red Hood tilted her head. There must be something else odd.
Red Hood was startled. This is not Grandmother!
The wolf jumped up! Red Hood, hide quickly! Tap the wardrobe!
Red Hood slipped into the wardrobe! The wolf looked all around but could not see her.
The wolf was full from eating Grandmother, and his eyes slowly closed. Zzz...
A hunter passing by the window heard the snoring. Tap, tap on the window!
What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house? The hunter came into the room.
It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!
The wolf hiccupped, hic! and Grandmother popped out, pop! Grandmother was not hurt at all!
The wolf was so startled that Run for your life! and he ran away out the window.
Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too. Grandma!
Everyone has tea together at Grandmother's table. Share a snack from the basket with each one!
Thank you, everyone! Grandmother smiled brightly.
I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.
Red Hood hooked her little finger again, and remembered today for a long, long time.
Tap! Put it in the basket.
Tap Red Hood! Hook your little finger.
Tap, tap, tap Red Hood! Walk one step at a time.
Where is the vase with the same color as the flower?
Tap Red Hood! Knock, knock, knock.
Grandmother, why are your ears so big?
All the better to hear you with~
Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?
All the better to see you with~
Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?
Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?
Tap what looks different from Grandmother in the picture!
Not the blanket. Look closely at the face.
Tap the odd part of the face!
Tap the wardrobe! Pop in and hide.
Tap the window!
Tap, tap, tap the wolf! Tickle him.
Tap the snack! Share with each one.
Tap Red Hood! Promise again.
A red flower! Tap the vase of the same color!
A red vase! Tap the sparkling vase!
A yellow flower! Tap the vase of the same color!
A yellow vase! Tap the sparkling vase!
A blue flower! Tap the vase of the same color!
A blue vase! Tap the sparkling vase!
Bread goes to Grandmother. Tap!
Milk goes to Red Hood. Tap!
Apple goes to Mr. Hunter. Tap!

ko.text: 왕과 왕비는 오래오래 아기를 기다렸어요. 드디어 예쁜 공주님이 태어났어요!
온 나라 사람들을 불러 잔치를 열자!
요정 일곱 명을 아기의 대모로 모셨어요. 금 접시도 일곱 개 놓았지요.
그런데 저기, 요정이 한 명 더 왔어요!
요정과 금 접시, 어느 쪽이 더 많아요? 더 많은 쪽을 톡 눌러요.
접시 하나에 요정 한 명… 어, 요정이 남았어요. 요정이 더 많아요. 다시 골라 봐요.
맞아요. 요정이 더 많아요. 요정 한 명은 접시가 없네요.
그럼 더 적은 쪽은 어느 쪽일까요? 더 적은 쪽을 톡 눌러요.
요정은 더 많은 쪽이에요. 더 적은 쪽을 찾아봐요.
맞아요. 접시가 더 적어요. 일곱 개뿐이에요.
탑에 너무 오래 살아서 모두가 잊어버린 요정이었어요.
열여섯 살이 되면 물레 바늘에 찔려 영영 깨어나지 않는 깊은 잠에 빠질 거야.
영영이 아니에요. 백 년이 지나면 깨어날 거예요. 그리고 왕자님이 올 거예요.
공주님이 열여섯 살이 되던 날, 왕과 왕비는 멀리 나들이를 갔어요.
공주님은 성 구석구석을 돌아다니다 탑 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요.
실을 잣고 있단다. 물레를 치우라는 말은 못 들었거든.
할머니가 실을 잣고 있어요. 제일 긴 실은 어느 것일까요? 톡 눌러요.
그 실은 제일 짧아요. 제일 긴 실을 찾아봐요.
그 실보다 더 긴 실이 있어요. 다시 찾아봐요.
그럼 제일 짧은 실은 어느 것일까요? 톡 눌러요.
그 실은 제일 길어요. 제일 짧은 실을 찾아봐요.
그 실보다 더 짧은 실이 있어요. 다시 찾아봐요.
우리 아가, 막내 요정 말대로 백 년을 자는구나.
공주님이 혼자 깨면 외로울 거야. 모두 함께 자요.
촛불도 잠들고, 성 둘레에는 가시덤불이 높이높이 자랐어요.
백 년이 흘렀어요. 낮과 밤이 몇 번이나 지났을까요.
저 안에 공주님이 백 년째 자고 있대요.
모두 쿨쿨 자요. 탁자 아래에서 자는 강아지를 찾아봐요.
맞아요. 꼬마 요리사가 요리사 옆에서 자요.
바로 그때, 백 년이 꽉 찼어요. 공주님이 스스로 눈을 떴어요.
그날 저녁 예배당에서 결혼식을 올렸지요. 이번에는 요정 여덟 명을 모두 불렀어요. 접시도 여덟 개!

en.text: The king and queen waited a long, long time for a baby. At last, a lovely little princess was born!
Let's invite the whole kingdom and hold a feast!
The baby giggled, tee-hee!
Seven fairies were invited to be the baby's godmothers. Seven golden plates were set out for them.
But look, over there! One more fairy has come!
Fairies or golden plates, which are there more of? Tap the side that has more.
One plate for one fairy... oh, a fairy is left over. There are more fairies. Try again.
That's right. There are more fairies. One fairy has no plate.
Then which side has fewer? Tap the side that has fewer.
The fairies are the side with more. Find the side with fewer.
That's right. There are fewer plates. Only seven.
Which fairy has no plate?
It was the fairy who had lived in a tower so long that everyone had forgotten her.
There is no plate for me... They left me out.
Oh dear, I forgot. I'm sorry.
I'll speak last.
I give you a pretty face.
I give you a kind heart.
I give you sweet words.
I give you light, graceful dancing.
I give you a song like a songbird.
I give you the gift of playing the flute.
The baby smiled softly in her sleep.
When she turns sixteen, she will prick her finger on a spindle and fall into a deep sleep from which she will never wake.
Not never. After a hundred years she will wake up. And a prince will come.
Take away every spindle in the whole kingdom!
Every spindle was gone.
On the day the princess turned sixteen, the king and queen went away on a journey.
The princess wandered all around the castle, and climbed up to the very top of the tower.
Grandma, what are you doing?
I'm spinning thread, dear. Nobody told me the spindles had to go.
Grandma is spinning thread. Which thread is the longest? Tap it.
That thread is the shortest. Find the longest one.
There is a thread longer than that one. Look again.
That's right. This thread is the longest.
Then which thread is the shortest? Tap it.
That thread is the longest. Find the shortest one.
There is a thread shorter than that one. Look again.
That's right. This thread is the shortest.
Let me try too!
Ouch... I'm so sleepy...
Oh my, oh dear! Is anybody there?
My darling, just as the youngest fairy said, you will sleep a hundred years.
The princess would be lonely waking up alone. Let's all sleep together.
The candles went to sleep too, and all around the castle, a thorn hedge grew higher and higher.
A hundred years went by. How many days and nights passed?
They say a princess has been sleeping in there for a hundred years.
I'll go and see.
The thorn hedge opened a path, just for the prince.
Shh, everyone is sleeping.
The prince walked on tiptoe, as quietly as he could.
Everyone is fast asleep. Find the puppy sleeping under the table.
Not there. Look under the table.
That's right. The puppy is sleeping under the table.
Find the bird sleeping on the shelf.
Not there. Look on the shelf.
That's right. The bird is sleeping on the shelf.
Find the little boy sleeping next to the cook.
Not there. Look next to the cook.
That's right. The little cook is sleeping next to the cook.
Just then, the hundred years were up. The princess opened her eyes all by herself.
Is that you, Prince? I've waited so long.
Hello, Princess.
Everyone in the castle stretched and woke up.
That evening they were married in the chapel. This time, all eight fairies were invited. And eight plates, too!
Thank you for inviting me too.
Everyone waved and said goodbye. Bye-bye!

ko.text: 옛날 어느 나라에 눈처럼 하얀 얼굴의 공주가 살았어요. 이름은 백설공주였어요.
왕비에게는 무엇이든 대답하는 신기한 거울이 있었어요.
거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
공주님, 저는 도저히 못 하겠어요. 멀리멀리 달아나세요.
백설공주는 어두운 숲을 혼자 달리고 또 달렸어요.
날이 저물 무렵, 백설공주는 숲속에서 아주 작은 집을 찾았어요.
어머, 정말 작은 집이네. 계세요? 아무도 안 계세요?
삐걱, 문이 열렸어요. 집 안에는 아무도 없었어요.
작은 식탁 위에 작은 접시와 작은 컵이 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
배가 너무 고파요. 한 접시에서 다 먹으면 미안하니까, 조금씩만 먹을게요.
백설공주는 접시마다 한 입씩, 컵마다 한 모금씩 먹었어요.
의자가 정말 작네. 조금 작지만… 영차, 앉았다!
방에는 작은 침대가 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
이 침대는 너무 짧아요. 다리가 안 펴져요.
이 침대는 불편해요. 발끝이 쿵 닿아요.
몸을 동그랗게 웅크리면… 조금 작지만 포근해요. 잘 자요…
밤이 되자, 산에서 일하던 일곱 난쟁이가 집으로 돌아왔어요.
어? 내 침대에 누가 자고 있어!
깜짝이야! 저는 백설공주예요. 갈 곳이 없어요. 여기서 지내도 될까요?
백설공주는 집안일을 하고, 난쟁이들은 산에서 일했어요. 모두 사이좋게 지냈어요.
침대가 몇 개일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
이제 잘 시간! 난쟁이들이 침대를 찾아요.
모두 잘 자요. 함께 지내서 행복해요.
숲속 일곱 난쟁이 집의 백설공주가 제일 예뻐요.
왕비는 할머니로 변장하고 빨간 사과를 들고 숲으로 갔어요.
문은 열면 안 돼요. 난쟁이들과 약속했거든요.
백설공주는 사과를 한 입 베어 물고, 그만 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
난쟁이들은 백설공주를 맑은 유리관에 눕히고, 날마다 곁을 지켰어요.
어느 날, 이웃 나라 왕자님이 숲을 지나가다 백설공주를 보았어요.
이 공주님을 제 성으로 모셔 가 정성껏 돌보고 싶어요.
그런데 관을 옮기다가 덜컹! 목에 걸렸던 사과 조각이 툭 빠졌어요.
낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.

en.text: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.
The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.
Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.
The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.
I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!
The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.
Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.
Thank you, mister.
Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.
As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.
Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?
Shall we knock on the door? Tap!
Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.
On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.
I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.
Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.
Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!
Haaaam, I am so sleepy.
In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.
This bed is too short. My legs won't stretch out.
This bed is uncomfortable. My toes bump the end.
If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...
Snow White drifted off to sleep.
At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.
Who sat in my chair?
Who ate from my plate?
Who ate my bread?
Who used my spoon?
Who used my fork?
Who drank from my cup?
Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!
In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.
Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?
Yes, I promise!
Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.
Bang-bang, thump-thump!
Wow, thank you!
How many beds are there? Tap to find out!
Time for bed! The dwarfs are looking for their beds.
Shall we find the red bed?
That is the red bed.
That's right, the red bed!
Shall we find the orange bed?
That is the orange bed.
That's right, the orange bed!
Shall we find the yellow bed?
That is the yellow bed.
That's right, the yellow bed!
Shall we find the green bed?
That is the green bed.
That's right, the green bed!
Shall we find the blue bed?
That is the blue bed.
That's right, the blue bed!
Shall we find the purple bed?
That is the purple bed.
That's right, the purple bed!
Shall we find the brown bed?
That is the brown bed.
That's right, the brown bed!
Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.
Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.
The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.
Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.
I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.
Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.
Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.
The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.
They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.
One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.
I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.
But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.
Shall we tap Snow White's hand?
Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.
You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.
Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
The queen went far, far away.

ko.text: 바람을 톡 눌러서 후~ 불어 줘요!
단추까지 꼭꼭 채웠어요. 외투는 꼼짝도 안 해요!
바람은 숨이 차서 헉헉, 볼이 쭈글쭈글해졌어요.
어? 날아간 모자가 나그네 머리에 쏙 떨어졌어요!
해님을 톡톡 눌러서 따뜻하게 비춰 줘요!
바람이 불 때, 나그네는 외투를 꽉 여몄어요.
누가 외투를 벗게 했을까요? 해님일까요, 바람일까요?
외투를 벗은 나그네 쪽 하늘을 봐요!
세게 미는 것보다 다정한 게 더 힘이 세요.
눈이 펑펑 오는 날엔 무엇을 입을까요?
바람아, 이번엔 살살 불어 줄래? 톡, 살살~
하늘을 톡 눌러서 날씨를 바꿔 볼까요?
해님과 바람은 오늘도 사이좋게 하늘을 지켜요.
다정한 마음이 제일 힘이 세답니다. 끝!

en.text: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.
Shall we tap the Sun?
Tap the smiling Sun!
"I'm the warmest!"
Now tap the Wind!
Tap the puffy-cheeked Wind!
"No way, I'm the strongest!"
The Sun and the Wind both say they're the best.
A traveler is walking down the road below.
The traveler is wearing a thick coat.
The Wind said, "Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!"
The Sun smiled. "Okay. Wind, you go first."
The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.
Tap the Wind to blow!
Tap the Wind and blow!
Stronger now! Tap!
Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!
"Oh no, my hat!" The hat flew far, far away.
The coat flap-flap-flaps!
"Brrr, it's cold!" The traveler held the coat tight.
Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!
The Wind blew even harder. Swish!
The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.
"Aw, it's not working!"
Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!
Now it's the Sun's turn.
Tap the Sun to shine nice and warm!
Tap the Sun!
"Ahh, so warm~" The traveler unbuttoned the coat.
A little more tapping!
"Phew, it's hot!" The traveler fans with the hat.
Tap one more time!
Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!
The Wind was so surprised. "Wow, the Sun did it!"
When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.
When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.
Who made the traveler take off the coat? Was it the Sun, or the Wind?
Who made the traveler take off the coat?
Look at the sky by the traveler without the coat!
It's the Sun! Tap the sparkling Sun!
That's right, it's the Sun! The warm Sun won!
Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.
What should we wear on a snowy day?
On cold days, warm clothes are best.
The coat! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing a warm coat feels so cozy.
What should we wear on a bright, sunny day?
On hot days, cool clothes are best.
The short sleeves! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing short sleeves feels so cool.
When it's cold, put it on. When it's hot, take it off.
The traveler is resting by the stream.
The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!
Wind, could you blow gently this time? Tap, gently~
Tap the Wind gently!
"Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!"
The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.
"Let's be good friends!"
Shall we tap the sky to change the weather?
The clothes change by themselves, too!
The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.
Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!

ko.text: 옛날 옛날 산골 오막살이에 엄마와 오누이가 살았어요.
엄마가 일하러 가요. 오누이를 톡 눌러서 인사해요!
오빠랑 동생을 톡 눌러서 "다녀오세요!" 해 봐요!
엄마는 부잣집에서 하루 종일 부지런히 일했어요.
호랑이 말풍선의 떡이랑 똑같이 생긴 접시를 골라요!
바구니에 남은 떡이랑 똑같은 개수의 접시를 골라요!
해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지고 있어요. 엄마가 첫째 고개를 넘어요.
하늘이 붉어졌어요. 엄마가 둘째 고개를 넘어요.
깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 엄마가 셋째 고개를 넘어요.
"어흥! 떡 한 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 한 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 두 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 두 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 세 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 세 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 네 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 네 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 다섯 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 다섯 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 여섯 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 여섯 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 일곱 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 일곱 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 여덟 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 여덟 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 아홉 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 아홉 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
"어흥! 떡 열 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
호랑이가 떡 열 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
호랑이는 떡 한 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
호랑이는 떡 두 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
호랑이는 떡 세 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.

"어흥! 남은 떡 몽땅 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
바구니에 남은 떡은 몇 개일까요? 세어 보고 접시를 골라요!
남은 떡을 몽땅 꿀꺽! 배가 빵빵해졌어요!
호랑이는 엄마 옷을 입고, 오누이가 기다리는 집으로 갔어요.
진짜 엄마 목소리를 톡 골라 봐요!
진짜 엄마 손은 뭘까요? 잘 보고 골라 봐요!
진짜 엄마 손을 톡 골라 봐요!
엄마 손은 손가락이 길쭉하고 떡가루가 묻어 있어요.
맞아요! 엄마 손은 부드럽고 떡가루가 묻어 있지요.
그런데 문틈으로 들어온 손은… 하얀 밀가루 사이로 발톱이 쏙! 엄마 손이 아니에요!
문밖에 누가 있는지 보고 싶어요. 창호지를 손가락으로 콕 뚫어 볼까요?
창호지를 톡 눌러서 콕 뚫어 봐요!
구멍 너머에 커다랗고 동그란 눈이 깜빡깜빡! 호랑이예요!
오누이는 뒷문으로 살금살금 나왔어요. 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 달려요!
앗, 호랑이가 오는 소리! 커다란 장독을 톡 눌러서 숨어요!
휴~ 이제 우물가 큰 나무로 달려가요! 톡톡!
우물가에 커다란 나무가 있어요. 톡톡 눌러서 영차영차 올라가요!
호랑이가 우물 속을 들여다봤어요. 우물 물에 오누이 얼굴이 비쳤거든요!
첨벙! 두레박에는 물만 가득. 우물 속 오누이 얼굴을 톡 눌러 봐요!
나무 위에서 오누이가 그만 킥킥 웃고 말았어요.
참기름 병을 톡 눌러서 나무에 발라 줘요!
호랑이가 도끼로 콕콕 찍으며 올라와요! 오누이는 덜덜 떨었어요.
호랑이가 점점 가까이 올라와요. 오누이는 두 손을 모았어요.
하늘에서 줄이 두 개 내려왔어요! 어떤 줄을 잡을까요?
굵고 반짝이는 튼튼한 줄을 톡 골라요!
줄을 꼭 잡고, 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 올라가요!
구름을 여섯 겹이나 뚫고, 오누이는 하늘 나라에 닿았어요!
호랑이도 하늘에 빌었어요. 그랬더니 낡은 줄이 스르르 내려왔어요.
호랑이는 혹을 달고 산속으로 줄행랑! 다시는 오지 않았대요.
하늘 나라에 간 오빠는 해님이, 동생은 달님이 되었어요.
그래서 동생은 해님, 오빠는 달님이 되었답니다.
해님이나 달님을 톡 눌러 봐요! 낮이 되고, 밤이 돼요.
해님 달님은 오늘도 하늘에서 우리를 환하게 비춰 준답니다.
두 목소리를 들어 봐요. 하나는 진짜 엄마, 하나는 가짜예요.
진짜 엄마 목소리를 톡 골라 봐요! 다시 들으려면 한 번 더 눌러요.
엄마 목소리는 다정하고 부드러웠어요. 다시 들어 봐요.
맞아요! 진짜 엄마 목소리예요. 그런데 문밖 목소리는 걸걸했지요?
앗, 호랑이가 오는 소리! 커다란 장독 뒤로 숨어요!
휴~ 이제 우물가 큰 나무로 달려가요!
우물가에 커다란 나무가 있어요. 톡! 영차영차 올라가요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a mom and her two children, a brother and a sister, lived in a little hut in the mountains.
Mom is going to work. Tap the brother and sister to say goodbye!
Tap the brother and sister to say "Take care, Mom!"
Mom said, "Lock the door tight and wait for Mom~"
Mom worked hard all day long at the rich family's house.
"Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!" Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!
Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!
The basket is full of rice cakes! "The children will love these!" Mom hurried off toward home.
Pick a plate of rice cakes and tap it!
That's the sparkly plate! Give it a tap!
Find the plate that matches the rice cakes in the tiger's speech bubble!
Find the plate with the same number of rice cakes as the ones left in the basket!
The sun is slowly setting. Mom is crossing the first hill.
The sky has turned red. Mom is crossing the second hill.
It is a dark, dark night. Mom is crossing the third hill.
"Roar! Give me one rice cake, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants one rice cake. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants two rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me three rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants three rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me four rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants four rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me five rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants five rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me six rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants six rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me seven rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants seven rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me eight rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants eight rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me nine rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants nine rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
"Roar! Give me ten rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
The tiger wants ten rice cakes. Which plate should we give?
The tiger gulps down one rice cake! What a round tummy!
The tiger gulps down two rice cakes! What a round tummy!
The tiger gulps down three rice cakes! What a round tummy!
The tiger gulps down four rice cakes! What a round tummy!
The tiger gulps down five rice cakes! What a round tummy!
Gulp! One more rice cake! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Two more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Three more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Four more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Five more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Six more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Seven more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Eight more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Nine more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
Gulp! Ten more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
"Roar! Give me all the leftover rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
How many rice cakes are left in the basket? Count them and pick a plate!
The tiger gulps down all the leftover rice cakes! What a big, round tummy!
When the rice cakes were all gone, the tiger said, "No more rice cakes? Then I'll have to eat you!"
The tiger ate Mom up with one big gulp.
The tiger put on Mom's clothes and went to the house where the brother and sister were waiting.
Knock, knock, knock. "Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~" The voice is rough and raspy.
Tap the real Mom's voice!
The sparkly one is Mom's voice!
The brother said, "That is not our mom's voice! Show us your hand!"
Which one is Mom's real hand? Look closely and pick!
"Huh? It is furry... and it has stripes!"
"Huh? It is white, but... it has sharp claws!"
Tap the real Mom's hand!
Mom's hand has long fingers, with rice cake flour on it.
The sparkly hand is Mom's hand!
That's right! Mom's hand is soft, with rice cake flour on it.
But the hand through the crack in the door... Sharp claws poke out from the white flour! That is not Mom's hand!
We want to see who is outside. Shall we poke a little hole in the paper door with a finger?
Tap the paper door to poke a hole!
Through the hole, a big round eye blinks and blinks! It is the tiger!
The brother whispered, "Shh, let's tiptoe out the back door!"
The brother and sister tiptoed out the back door. Tap the screen to run!
Tap the screen to run!
Oh no, the tiger is coming! Tap the big jar to hide!
Tap the big jar to hide!
"Kids~ where did you go?" The tiger looked around and around, then went back toward the house.
Phew~ Now run to the big tree by the well! Tap, tap!
There is a big tree by the well. Tap, tap, and climb up, heave-ho!
Tap the screen again and again to climb the tree!
The brother and sister climbed all the way to the top of the tree!
The tiger came to the backyard. "Aha! They are hiding in the well!"
The tiger peeked into the well. The brother's and sister's faces were shining in the water!
"I'll scoop them up with the bucket~" Heave-ho!
Splash! The bucket is full of just water. Tap the faces of the brother and sister in the well!
Tap the faces in the well!
Up in the tree, the brother and sister couldn't help giggling.
"Huh? A laugh from up above?" The tiger looked up with a jerk.
The tiger looked up and asked, "Kids, how did you climb up there?"
The brother thought up a trick. "We rubbed on sesame oil and climbed up!"
Tap the sesame oil bottle to rub the oil on the tree!
Tap the sesame oil bottle!
Slip, slide! The tiger kept on slipping down.
Then the sister burst out laughing and blurted, "We chopped with an axe, chop, chop, and climbed up~"
The brother said "Shh!" but... it was too late! The tiger had already heard!
The tiger is climbing up, chopping with an axe! The brother and sister shivered and shook.
The tiger is getting closer and closer. The brother and sister put their hands together.
"Dear Sky, please send down a strong rope!"
Two ropes came down from the sky! Which rope should we grab?
Creak... This rope is old!
Tap the thick, shiny, strong rope!
Look for the thick, sparkly, strong rope!
The thick, shiny rope is the strong rope!
That's right! It is the thick, shiny, new rope.
Hold the rope tight and tap the screen to climb!
Tap the screen to climb!
Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!
Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!
The tiger prayed to the sky too. And an old rope slid slowly down.
"Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!" A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.
The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.
In the land in the sky, the brother became the Sun, and the sister became the Moon.
The sister said, "Big brother, I am scared of the night."
"Then let's switch!"
So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.
Tap the Sun or the Moon! It becomes day, and it becomes night.
Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.
Listen to the two voices. One is the real Mom, and one is a fake.
Voice number one.
Voice number two.
Which number is the real Mom's voice?
Tap the real Mom's voice! Tap once more to hear it again.
"Roar~" That is the tiger pretending to be Mom!
Mom's voice was warm and gentle. Listen again.
That's right! It is the real Mom's voice. But the voice outside the door was rough, wasn't it?
The children tiptoed out the back door.
Oh! The tiger is coming! Hide behind the big jar!
Phew! Now run to the big tree by the well!
There is a big tree by the well. Tap! Heave-ho, up we climb.
Hold on tight and climb, heave-ho!
Tap the rice cakes one by one!
Tap the screen!

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 아기 돼지 삼 형제가 살았어요.
삼 형제는 엄마께 인사하고 길을 떠났어요.
손가락으로 톡 눌러서 바람을 불어 봐요.
첫째는 짚으로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 짚을 톡톡톡 쌓아요!
뚝딱! 짚 집이 완성됐어요. 첫째는 피리를 불며 놀았어요.
둘째는 나무로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 망치로 톡톡톡톡톡!
쿵쾅쿵쾅! 나무 집이 완성됐어요. 둘째는 바이올린을 켜며 놀았어요.
셋째는 벽돌로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 벽돌은 무거워서 열 장을 천천히 쌓아요.
벽돌을 열 장 다 쌓았어요. 튼튼한 벽돌 집이 완성됐어요!
손가락으로 톡톡 눌러서 늑대와 같이 후~ 불어요.
아기 돼지 둘은 막내네 집으로 달려갔어요.
두 형은 숨이 차서 헉헉! 어느 집으로 가야 할까요?
짚은 너무 가벼워요. 다시 골라 봐요.
맞아요! 가장 튼튼한 벽돌 집이에요. 삼 형제는 문을 꼭 닫았어요.
삼 형제는 모두 모였어요. 하나, 둘, 셋을 세어 볼까요?
집을 톡톡 눌러서 몇 번 부는지 세어 봐요.
후~ 후~ 여덟 번이나 불었지만 벽돌 집은 끄떡없어요!
늑대는 지붕으로 살금살금 올라갔어요. 굴뚝으로 몰래 들어가려고요.
아기 돼지들은 큰 솥에 물을 팔팔 끓였어요.
불을 톡톡 눌러서 크게 해 줘요.
보글보글 물이 끓어요! 그때 굴뚝에서 늑대가 쑥 내려왔어요.
늑대는 굴뚝으로 휙! 날아가서 멀리멀리 도망쳤어요. 다시는 오지 않았어요.
이제 늑대는 오지 않아요. 아기 돼지들은 벽돌 집을 더 지었어요.
집을 톡 눌러서 새 집을 지어요.
하나, 둘, 셋! 튼튼한 벽돌 집이 세 채가 되었어요.
삼 형제는 튼튼한 집에서 오래오래 행복하게 살았어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, three little pigs lived together.
Mother Pig said. You are all grown up now. Go out into the world and build a house of your own.
Tap a little pig.
The three brothers said goodbye to Mother and set off on the road.
Look carefully at the little pigs' clothes.
Which pig is wearing a scarf?
Which pig is wearing a yellow hat?
Which pig is wearing a white hat?
Which pig is wearing blue overalls?
Which pig is wearing red overalls?
That's right! This is the pig.
Look once more, carefully.
Tap the sparkling pig.
At the shop, they decided to try blowing wind.
Straw flies away. It is very light.
Wood wobbles! It is a little bit strong.
Bricks don't budge! They are very, very strong.
Tap with your finger to blow the wind.
Tap what you want to build with.
The first pig decided to build with straw. Tap, tap, tap, stack the straw!
Ta-da! The straw house is done. The first pig played his flute.
The second pig decided to build with wood. Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap with the hammer!
Bang, bang! The wood house is done. The second pig played his violin.
His brothers teased him. Still building? Come and play with us! But the third pig kept stacking bricks, slowly.
The third pig decided to build with bricks. Bricks are heavy, so stack ten of them slowly.
He stacked all ten bricks. A strong brick house is done!
Tap, tap with your finger and blow, hoo, together with the wolf.
Then a hungry wolf came along, sniff, sniff. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
The first pig said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it away!
The straw house flew away!
The first pig ran to his brother's house.
Then the wolf came to the wood house too. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
The first and second pigs said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it down!
The wood house tumbled down!
The two little pigs ran to their youngest brother's house.
The two brothers were out of breath, huff, puff! Which house should they go to?
Pick the strongest house!
Straw is too light. Try again.
The brick house is the strongest!
That's right! It's the strongest brick house. The three brothers shut the door tight.
All three brothers were together. Shall we count them: one, two, three?
Tap a little pig.
We're together, all three. I'm not scared!
The wolf came to the brick house. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
No, no, no! Then I'll huff and puff and blow!
Tap the house to count how many times he blows.
Huff, puff! He blew eight times, but the brick house did not budge!
The wolf was out of breath and plopped down.
The wolf crept up onto the roof. He wanted to sneak in through the chimney.
The little pigs boiled water in a big pot.
Tap, tap the fire to make it bigger.
Bubble, bubble, the water is boiling! Then the wolf slid down the chimney.
Ouch, it's hot!
The wolf whooshed up the chimney and ran far, far away. He never came back.
The wolf never came again. The little pigs built more brick houses.
Tap the house to build a new one.
One, two, three! Now there were three strong brick houses.
The three brothers lived happily in their strong houses for a long, long time.

ko.text: 봄이 왔어요. 할아버지가 텃밭에 구멍을 팠어요.
파란 싹이 났어요! 물도 주고 햇볕도 줘요.
여름이 되었어요. 순무 잎이 할아버지 키만큼 자랐어요!
할아버지가 순무 잎을 꽉 잡았어요. 톡 눌러서 영차!
혼자서는 안 되겠어요. 할아버지가 할머니를 불러요!
할머니가 할아버지 허리를 잡고, 톡! 영차!
순무가 한 뼘 올라왔어요! 그래도 안 뽑혀요.
음매~ 소는 풀을 먹고 있대요. 사람 친구를 먼저 불러요!
조금 더 올라왔어요! 누가 더 도와줄까요?
멍멍 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
강아지가 손녀 치마를 꼭 붙잡았어요. 영차!
야옹 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
흙구멍에서 찍찍 소리가 나요. 톡 눌러 봐요!
이번엔 여섯이 다 함께! 순무를 톡톡 눌러요. 영~차!
쑥! 커다란 순무가 뽑혔어요! 모두 벌렁 넘어졌어요.
작은 생쥐까지 모두 힘을 모았더니 뽑혔어요!
누가 먼저 순무를 잡았지? 차례대로 톡 눌러 봐요!
와! 할아버지, 할머니, 손녀, 강아지, 고양이, 생쥐! 차례를 다 기억했어요.
순무국을 한 그릇씩 나눠 줘요. 냄비를 톡 눌러요!
여섯 그릇, 여섯 명! 딱 맞아요.

en.text: Spring came. Grandpa dug a hole in the garden.
"Turnip, grow big and strong." Tap the seed!
Tap the seed!
The seed slipped right into the soil.
A green sprout popped up! It gets water and sunshine too.
Tap, tap the turnip sprout!
Summer came. The turnip leaves grew as tall as Grandpa!
Grandpa grabbed the turnip leaves tight. Tap and heave-ho!
Tap Grandpa to heave-ho!
The turnip won't budge.
Grandpa can't do it alone. Grandpa calls Grandma!
Oof! Grandpa plopped down on the ground.
Grandma came running. "Let's do it together!"
Grandma held on to Grandpa's waist. Tap! Heave-ho!
Tap, tap the turnip and heave-ho!
The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.
Who will Grandma call?
Moo~ The cow is busy eating grass. Let's call a people friend first!
It's the granddaughter! Tap the sparkling friend!
"Sweetie~!" The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!
It came up a little more! Who will help next?
Woof woof from behind the bush! Who could it be?
Who goes woof woof? Listen again.
It's the puppy! Tap the sparkling friend!
The puppy came bounding out. "I'll help too!"
The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!
Meow from the barn roof! Who could it be?
Who goes meow? Listen again.
It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!
The cat hopped down from the roof.
Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.
"Hmph!" But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.
Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.
Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground. Tap it!
Tap the mouse in the hole!
A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.
"You're too small. It won't work~"
"Me too!" The mouse held the cat's tail tight.
This time, all six together! Tap the turnip. Heave-ho!
Tap the turnip. Heave-ho!
Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.
When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!
They cooked yummy turnip soup.
Who grabbed the turnip first? Tap them in order!
Who was first?
Who grabbed on after Grandpa?
Who grabbed on after Grandma?
Who grabbed on after the granddaughter?
Who grabbed on after the puppy?
Who grabbed on after the cat?
It's Grandpa! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's Grandma! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the mouse! Tap the sparkling friend!
Grandpa: "I'm next~"
Grandma: "I'm next~"
The granddaughter: "I'm next~"
The puppy: "I'm next~"
The cat: "I'm next~"
The mouse: "I'm next~"
Wow! Grandpa, Grandma, the granddaughter, the puppy, the cat, the mouse! You remembered the whole order.
Let's share the soup, one bowl each. Tap the pot!
Tap the pot for one bowl each!
Six bowls for six friends! Just right.
They all ate it up together, yum.

ko.text: 따뜻한 여름날, 엄마 오리가 둥지에서 알을 품고 있었어요.
노란 아기 오리 넷이 나왔어요. 삐약삐약!
어? 제일 큰 알은 아직이에요. 톡! 두드려 볼까요?
크고 회색인 아기 오리가 나왔어요! 머리에 알껍데기 모자를 썼네요.
엄마 오리가 아기들을 데리고 연못에 갔어요. 줄을 서서 헤엄쳐요.
회색 아기 오리는 헤엄을 제일 잘해요! 쏙 들어갔다가 퐁!
그런데 늘 줄 맨 끝에서 혼자 따라가요.
농장 마당에 닭이랑 오리들이 모여 있어요.
혼자 남은 아기 오리 마음은 어떨까요?
아기 오리 얼굴을 잘 봐요. 눈썹이랑 입이 어떻게 생겼지?
기쁜 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
슬픈 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
무서워하는 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
화난 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
맞아요. 아기 오리는 슬퍼요. 눈물이 똑 떨어졌어요.
아기 오리를 톡 눌러서 쓰다듬어 줄까요? "괜찮아."
그래도 아기 오리는 마음이 쓸쓸했어요. 넓은 세상을 보러 길을 떠났어요.
갈대가 아기 오리 머리보다 훨씬 높아요.
뒤뚱뒤뚱, 갈대숲을 지나 넓은 늪에 닿았어요.
저 멀리서 큰 소리가 났어요. 깜짝 놀란 기러기들이 모두 날아가 버렸어요.
맞아요. 아기 오리는 무서워요. 갈대 속에 웅크렸어요.
갈대를 톡 눌러서 아기 오리를 살포시 덮어 줄까요?
쉿, 이제 조용해요. 아기 오리는 갈대 속에서 포근하게 쉬었어요.
어느덧 가을이 되었어요. 아기 오리는 조금 더 자라 어린 새가 되었어요.
하늘 높이 하얀 새들이 줄지어 날아가요.
추운 겨울이 왔어요. 호수가 꽁꽁 얼어서 발이 얼음에 붙어 버렸어요.
아기 오리가 날개로 몸을 감싸서 따뜻하게!
날개로 몸을 꼭 감쌌더니 조금 따뜻해졌어요.
쩍! 얼음이 깨졌어요. 발이 쏙 빠졌어요!
농부 할아버지가 아기 오리를 품에 폭 안았어요. 따뜻한 집으로 가요!
할머니 집은 난로가 있어 따뜻했어요. 고양이와 암탉도 함께 살았어요.
가르릉이 아니라 꽥! 모두 깔깔 웃었어요. 아기 오리도 웃었어요.
맞아요! 아기 오리는 헤엄을 제일 잘해요.
따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 아기 오리는 몸이 부쩍 자랐어요.
아기 오리를 톡! 눌러서 날개를 활짝 펴 볼까요?
아기 오리가 호숫가에 내려앉았어요. 물에 누가 비쳤을까요?
길고 하얀 목, 커다란 하얀 날개…
어떻게 자랐는지 순서대로 톡! 맨 처음은 뭐였지?
어린 새예요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
알, 아기, 어린 새, 그리고 백조! 이렇게 자랐어요.
백조들을 톡톡 눌러서 함께 춤을 춰요!
다르게 생겼던 아기 오리는 이렇게 멋진 백조로 자랐답니다.
백조 얼굴을 잘 봐요. 눈썹이랑 입이 어떻게 생겼지?

en.text: On a warm summer day, Mama Duck sat on her nest, keeping her eggs warm.
Four little yellow ducklings hatched. Peep peep!
Hm? The biggest egg is still waiting. Tap it!
Tap the big egg!
A big gray duckling hatched! Look, an eggshell hat on its head.
Pop! The hat fell off.
Mama Duck said. "Oh my, this baby is big and gray. That's okay. You are all my babies!"
Mama Duck took her babies to the pond. They swam in a line.
Shall we tap to swim?
Tap! Swim!
The gray duckling swims the best! Dive in, and pop up!
But the gray duckling always follows at the very end of the line, all alone.
Chickens and ducks are gathered in the farmyard.
The rooster said. "Cock-a-doodle-doo! You're ugly!"
The ducks said. "Quack quack! You're not like us!"
How does the duckling feel?
How does the duckling feel now?
How does the lonely duckling feel?
How does the swan feel now?
Look closely at the duckling's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?
It's a happy face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's a sad face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's a scared face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's an angry face! Tap the sparkling face.
That's right. The duckling is sad. A tear dropped.
Shall we tap the duckling to give it a gentle pat? "It's okay."
Tap! Give the duckling a gentle pat.
"It's okay. You are wonderful just as you are."
Mama Duck said too. "My baby swims the best!"
The rooster and the ducks felt shy and said. "Sorry for teasing you."
Still, the duckling felt lonely. So it set off to see the wide world.
The reeds are much taller than the duckling's head.
Tap to push the reeds apart.
Tap! Push the reeds apart.
Waddle, waddle, past the reeds, and on to a wide marsh.
Geese lived in the marsh.
The geese said. "Hello! Let's play together!"
That's right! The duckling is happy to have made friends.
The geese and the duckling played and played.
A loud noise came from far away. The startled geese all flew off.
That's right. The duckling is scared. It curled up in the reeds.
Shall we tap the reeds to cover the duckling softly?
Tap the reeds! Cover it softly.
Shh, it's quiet now. The duckling rested cozily in the reeds.
Before long, it was autumn. The duckling had grown a little and become a young bird.
White birds are flying high in the sky, in a line.
Whoo~ A sound like a trumpet! They are swans.
The duckling gazed up at the sky for a long, long time. "I want to fly like that, too."
Cold winter came. The lake froze solid, and the duckling's feet got stuck in the ice.
The duckling wraps its wings around itself to keep warm!
Wrapped tight in its wings, the duckling got a little warmer.
Then an old farmer passed by and saw the duckling. "Oh dear, your feet are stuck in the ice!"
Crack! The ice broke. The feet popped out!
The old farmer hugged the duckling close in both arms. Off to a warm house!
Grandma's house was warm, with a stove. A cat and a hen lived there too.
The cat said. "Meow. Can you purr?"
The duckling tried to copy it.
Not a purr, but a quack! Everyone burst out laughing. The duckling laughed too.
The hen said. "Cluck cluck. Then can you lay an egg?" The duckling shook its head.
What is the duckling good at?
Cat: "I'm good at purring~"
Hen: "I'm good at laying eggs~"
Remember? Dive into the pond, and pop up!
It's swimming! Tap the sparkling card.
That's right! The duckling swims the best.
The cat and the hen nodded. "I see! Everyone is good at different things."
Warm spring came. The duckling grew bigger and bigger.
Shall we tap the duckling to spread its wings wide?
Tap! Wings wide open!
Wow, the wings have grown so big!
Flap flap! The duckling is flying in the sky!
The duckling landed by the lake. Who is in the water?
A long white neck, big white wings…
"Huh? Is that me?" The duckling was a white swan!
Tap them in the order the duckling grew! What came first?
What came after the egg?
What came after the baby?
What came after the young bird?
"I'm next~"
It's the egg! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the baby! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the young bird! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the swan! Tap the sparkling card.
Egg, baby, young bird, and then swan! That's how it grew.
The swans swam over. "Hello! You're our friend too. Let's live together!"
That's right! The swan is so, so happy.
Far away, Mama Duck and the other ducklings wave their wings happily. "You've grown so much!"
Tap the swans to dance together!
The duckling who looked different grew into a wonderful swan, just like this.
Look closely at the swan's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?

ko.text: 언덕 위에 작은 아이가 서 있어요. 하늘을 올려다보고 있어요.
여기 색깔 조각이 세 개 있어요. 빨간 조각을 톡, 눌러 봐요.
아이는 구름 나라로 올라가 보기로 했어요.
구름 섬에 양 한 마리가 혼자 앉아 있어요.
양이 앉은 구름을 톡, 눌러 봐요.
아이와 양은 손을 잡고 구름 길을 걸었어요.
양은 집으로 돌아갔어요. 유니콘은 아직 보이지 않아요.
밤이 되자, 아이는 별빛 숲으로 들어갔어요.
사슴 다리에 가시가 박혔어요. 가시를 톡, 눌러 봐요. 살살 빼 줄게요.
아이는 사슴의 작은 뿔을 가만히 보았어요.
폭포 위에 무지개가 떠 있어요. 말 한 마리가 서 있어요.
말은 아이의 간식 바구니를 보고 있어요.
달빛 아래, 하얀 유니콘이 서 있었어요.
네가 친절한 걸 다 보고 있었어.

en.text: On a hill stands a little child, looking up at the sky.
I want to meet a real unicorn.
Here are three coloured blocks. Tap the red one.
That is right! It is red.
The child decided to climb up to the cloud country.
On a cloud island, a little sheep sat all alone.
Sniff... How do I get home...
Tap the cloud the sheep is sitting on.
The sheep hopped right down!
Let's go together!
The child and the sheep walked the cloud path hand in hand.
Thank you! I can see my home now!
The sheep went home. The unicorn was still nowhere to be seen.
When night came, the child walked into the starlight forest.
Ouch, ouch...
There are thorns in the deer's leg. Tap a thorn, and we will pull them out gently.
All three thorns are out!
Thank you! It doesn't hurt at all now.
The child looked quietly at the deer's little antlers.
You're... not a unicorn.
A rainbow hangs over the waterfall. A horse is standing there.
Grrrumble...
The horse was looking at the child's snack basket.
Here, let's share.
The horse munched the snack happily.
Thank you! That was delicious.
You're not... a unicorn either.
The sun went down, and the road was empty.
Maybe... there is no real unicorn.
The child trudged along, looking only at the ground.
Just then, a small sound came from behind.
The child slowly turned around.
There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.
I was here all along.
I saw how kind you were, every time.
A unicorn...!
Tap the unicorn to say hello.
The child hugged the unicorn tight.

ko.text: 아주 먼 옛날, 엄마 염소와 일곱 마리 아기 염소가 살았어요.
어느 날, 엄마 염소가 바구니를 들고 말했어요.
"엄마는 풀을 뜯으러 다녀올게. 늑대가 오면 문을 열어 주면 안 돼!"
"늑대는 목소리가 걸걸하고, 발이 시커멓단다. 꼭 기억해!"
엄마가 가고 얼마 뒤, 문밖에서 소리가 났어요.
늑대는 밀가루를 발에 묻혀서, 하얀 발을 쑥 내밀었어요.
그런데 들어온 건 엄마가 아니라 늑대였어요!
막내는 키 큰 시계 속에 쏙 숨었어요. 아무도 몰랐어요.
늑대는 시계 속만 빼고, 아기 염소들을 모두 찾아내서 꿀꺽 삼켜 버렸어요.
하지만 아기 염소들은 다치지 않았어요. 아주 따뜻하고 포근한 뱃속이었거든요.
집에 돌아온 엄마 염소는 깜짝 놀랐어요.
늑대는 배가 불러서, 나무 아래에서 쿨쿨 자고 있었어요.
"쉿! 늑대가 깨지 않게, 그림자 극장에서 아기들을 꺼내 줄게."
하얀 종이 극장에 엄마의 그림자가 나타났어요.
슥삭슥삭, 가위질을 하자 아기 염소들이 하나씩 나와요!
엄마가 바늘로 콕콕콕 꿰맸어요. 늑대는 아무것도 몰랐어요.
늑대는 흠뻑 젖은 채 멀리멀리 도망갔어요.
엄마와 일곱 아기 염소는 손을 잡고 신나게 춤을 추었어요.
아기 염소를 톡! 눌러 같이 춤춰 봐요!
엄마 목소리를 잘 아는 아기 염소들은 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.
막내 염소를 톡 눌러서 시계 속에 숨겨 줘요!

en.text: Long, long ago, a mother goat and seven little kids lived together.
One day, Mother Goat picked up a basket and said,
I'm going out to eat some grass. Don't open the door if the wolf comes!
The wolf has a rough voice and black paws. Remember!
Yes, Mother! The little goats answered in loud voices.
Soon after Mother left, there was a sound outside the door.
Children, it's Mother. Open the door! It was a rough voice.
The little goats looked at each other.
That voice is rough. You're not our mother! said the oldest kid.
Go away, wolf! the little goats shouted.
The wolf thought hard.
I need a sweet voice. Shall I eat some chalk?
The wolf's voice became thin and sweet.
Children, it's Mother. Open the door, please~
Then show us your paw through the crack! said the little goats.
The wolf dipped his paw in flour and stuck out a white paw.
Achoo! The wolf sneezed flour.
Oh? A white paw! It's Mother! The little goats were fooled and opened the door.
But it was not Mother who came in. It was the wolf!
Hide, hide! The little goats hid in the blankets and in the laundry basket, pop, pop.
Where will the youngest hide?
The youngest hid inside the tall clock. Nobody knew.
Where did you hide? I'll find every one of you! The wolf searched the house.
The wolf found all the little goats except the one in the clock, and gulped them down.
But the little goats were not hurt. It was warm and cozy inside his tummy.
Mother Goat came home and was very surprised.
Children, where are you? Mother is home!
Mother! The youngest hopped out of the clock.
The wolf gulped down my brothers and sisters!
Don't worry. Mother will save them! Mother took her scissors and needle.
The wolf was full, and he was fast asleep under a tree.
Mother and the youngest tiptoed closer.
Shh! So the wolf won't wake up, I'll bring the little ones out at the shadow theater.
Mother's shadow appeared in the white paper theater.
Snip, snip! With each cut, the little goats came out one by one!
Mother! All six little goats came out safe and sound.
Now let's put stones in the wolf's tummy.
Mother stitched with her needle, poke, poke, poke. The wolf did not notice a thing.
The wolf woke up and stumbled to his feet.
Oh dear, my tummy is so heavy. I'm thirsty!
I must drink water from the well.
Splash! The wolf fell into the well.
Yikes, it's cold! I'm never coming back!
The wolf ran far, far away, dripping wet.
Mother and the seven little goats held hands and danced happily.
Tap a little goat to dance together!
The little goats who knew Mother's voice well lived happily for a long, long time.
Tap Mother Goat!
Tap the youngest goat to hide him in the clock!
Tap, tap the screen!
Tap the wolf!
Tap the stone!
